blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Most automated survey generation systems retrieve papers as flat documents, limiting their ability to capture research structure. We present SurveyGraph, a framework built around a Methods-Entity Knowledge Graph (MEKG) encoding method-level follow-on, competition, and shared-resource relations. The graph supports core-paper discovery, retrieval, hybrid outlining, and evidence-gated narrative synthesis. We evaluate retrieval, semantic edges, citation grounding, collection coverage, and generation-stage components. In a controlled seven-method equal-budget benchmark, MEKG-anchored fusion balances recall and structural density, with an independent co-citation check. In a separate archived graph-native diagnostic, graph-aware retrieval nearly doubles recall over flat lexical baselines across eight runs (p = 0.004). A semantic evidence gate achieves AUC = 0.75. Audits of 160 generated sentences find 80.6% anchored-or-partial citation support. Human adjudication of 108 stratified semantic edges finds 68.5% supported-or-partial relations (binary-support Cohen's kappa = 0.64), with improves strongest (80.6%) and extends weakest (52.8%). A SurveyBench-facing collection probe reaches mean reference coverage of 0.521 across four topics with an eight-paper budget. Same-backend Qwen diagnostics on a 30-paper/74-relation graph show reduced organization signals when hybrid outlining is removed. Concurrent-system comparisons provide bounded context rather than matched-backend end-to-end evidence. The results position MEKG as an auditable structural layer for typed diagnostics, relation-specific filtering, and controlled survey generation. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/xzzvsxd/SurveyGraph.
blocks.zh: 大多数自动化的勘测生成系统将论文作为平面文件检索,限制了它们捕捉研究结构的能力. 我们介绍调查Graph,这是一个围绕方法-实体知识图(MEKG)编码方法层面的后续、竞争和共享资源关系的框架。 该图支持核心纸的发现,检索,混合概述,以及证据化的叙事综合. 我们评价检索、语义边缘、引号定位、收集覆盖和生成阶段组件。 在受控的七法平预算基准中,MEKG-安心核聚变平衡召回和结构密度,并有独立的引用检查. 在单独存档的图-内在诊断中,图-知的检索几乎翻了一番,比八行的平面法基线(p=0.004)。 语义证据门实现AUC=0.75. 对160个生成的句子的审计发现有80.6%的锁定或部分引用支持. 对108个分层语义边缘的人类判断发现68.5%的支持-或部分关系(二元-支持科恩的kappa=0.64),改善最强(80.6%),扩展最弱(52.8%). 一项调查奔驰收集探测器在有8份文件预算的四个题目上的平均参考覆盖率为0.521。 30纸/74-关系图上的同后端Quen诊断显示混合图解时组织信号减少. 同时期系统比较提供了有约束的上下文,而不是匹配的后端端到端的证据. 结果将MEKG定位为可审计的结构层,用于打字诊断,针对关系进行过滤,以及可控调查生成. 代码和文物:https://github.com/xzzvsxd/SurveyGraph. 中国植物物种信息数据库.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Scientific publishing continues to accelerate ( Bornmann and Mutz, 2015 ) , making coherent, well-grounded survey writing increasingly expensive and time-consuming. This pressure has motivated a fast-growing line of LLM-based survey generation systems, including AutoSurvey ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , SurveyX ( Liang et al., 2025 ) , SurveyForge ( Yan et al., 2025 ) , and SciSage ( Shi et al., 2025 ) . These systems have improved literature collection, outline drafting, and long-form generation, but most still operate over a document-centric view of the literature.
blocks.zh: 科学出版继续加速(Bornmann and Mutz, 2015),使得连贯而有根据的调查写作越来越昂贵和耗时. 这种压力促使以LLM为基础的调查生成系统快速增长,包括AutoSurvey(Wang等,2024年),SurveyX. (梁等,2025年.),"勘测福尔格"(燕等,2025年.),"史记"(史等,2025年. 这些系统改进了文献收集,提纲起草,以及长式生成,但大多数仍然在文献的以文件为中心的视角上运作.

blocks.en: The core bottleneck is structural blindness . Flat RAG pipelines retrieve papers by lexical or embedding similarity, yet high-quality survey writing depends on recovering the evolutionary structure of a field: which work extends which idea, which methods branch into competing families, and which benchmarks define phase transitions. For example, a survey of LLM-based agents should distinguish ReAct-style reasoning–action loops ( Yao et al., 2022 ) from Toolformer-style self-supervised tool use ( Schick et al., 2023 ) , rather than treating these papers as interchangeable topical matches. Without explicit relations, generated surveys become a collage of local summaries rather than a structured account of scientific development.
blocks.zh: 核心瓶颈是结构盲. 平坦的RAG管线通过词汇学或嵌入相似性来取回相纸,然而高质量的调查写作则取决于恢复一个领域的演化结构:哪个工作延伸出哪个想法,哪个方法将分入相竞争的家庭,以及哪些基准来定义相位过渡. 例如,对基于LLM的代理的调查应当区分ReAct-style推理-动作循环(姚等,2022年)和Tolformer-style自控工具的使用(Schick等,2023年),而不是将这些论文视为可互换的话题匹配. 没有明确的关系,所产生的调查就成了地方摘要的拼接,而不是科学发展的有条理的叙述。

blocks.en: The automated survey-generation landscape changed rapidly in 2025–2026. New systems increasingly inject planning, memory, and structure into the generation loop, including evolving plans in SurveyGen-I ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , quality-aware retrieval in SurveyGen ( Bao et al., 2025 ) , multi-view structure-first generation in MVSS ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , and structured retrieval in StructSurvey ( Pedinotti and Santus, 2026 ) . In parallel, evaluation has become stricter, with benchmarks such as SurveyBench ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , SurveyLens ( Guo et al., 2026 ) , and DeepSurvey-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . This landscape demands systems that not only generate high-quality text but also provide transparent, verifiable evidence for their structural decisions.
blocks.zh: 2025-2026年自动勘测-生成地貌变化迅速. 新系统越来越多地向生成循环注入规划、内存和结构,包括SurveyGen-I(Chen等,2025年)中不断演变的计划、SurveyGen(Bao等,2025年)中的质量意识检索、MVSS(Liu等,2026年)中多视图结构的第一代以及StructSurvey(Pedinotti和Santus,2026年)中的结构检索。 同时,评价也变得更加严格,基准有"调查本克"(Survey Bench (Sun等,2025年),"调查本克"(SurveyLens (Guo等,2026年))和"调查本克"(DeepSurvey-Bench (Zhang等,2026年)等. 这种格局要求系统不仅产生高质量的文本,而且为其结构决定提供透明、可核查的证据。

blocks.en: To address this, we propose SurveyGraph , a framework centered on a Methods-Entity Knowledge Graph (MEKG) that encodes method-level follow-on, competition, shared tasks, and temporal dependencies. The graph is reused throughout the pipeline: it supports core-paper discovery, hybrid outline generation, graph-aware retrieval, and narrative synthesis. Our evaluation combines controlled retrieval benchmarks, semantic-edge validation, citation grounding audits, and SurveyBench-facing collection probes to demonstrate the value and limits of typed graph structure.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,我们提议调查Graph(SurveyGraph),这是一个以方法-实体知识图(MEKG)为中心的框架,它编码了方法层面的后续、竞争、共同的任务和时间依赖。 该图在整个管道中被再用:它支持核心纸的发现,混合图谱生成,图感回取,和叙事合成. 我们的评价结合了控制检索基准、语义尖端验证、引用地基审计和Survey Bench-facing收集探测器,以显示打入的图表结构的价值和限度。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold. First, we present SurveyGraph , a graph-centric framework coupling MEKG construction, graph-aware retrieval, hybrid outline generation, and evolutionary narrative synthesis; unlike flat-RAG or citation-only approaches, MEKG encodes typed method-level relations that enable auditable, structure-preserving retrieval and generation. Second, we conduct a multi-level evaluation: (i) a seven-method equal-budget retrieval benchmark demonstrating that MEKG-anchored fusion achieves the best recall–density tradeoff, (ii) statistically significant gains on the archived graph-native diagnostic ( p = 0.004 p{=}0.004 ), (iii) citation-grounding audits confirming 80.6% anchored-or-partial support, (iv) human validation ( κ = 0.64 \kappa{=}0.64 , 108 edges), (v) SurveyBench-facing collection and bounded comparison diagnostics, and (vi) same-backend Qwen generation diagnostics that clarify the role of hybrid outlining/evolution modules without claiming leaderboard parity. Third, we release all artifacts, evaluation scripts, the annotation package, and reproducibility traces.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面。 首先,我们介绍SurveyGraph(SurveyGraph),一个以图表为中心的框架,将MEKG构建,图感检索,混合大纲生成,以及演化的叙述式合成相配合;与平面-RAG或只引用的方法不同,MEKG编码了打入的方法级关系,这些关系可以进行审核,结构保存检索和生成. 其次,我们进行了多层次的评估:(一) 一个七种方法的平预算检索基准,表明MEKG-预置聚变能实现最佳的回溯-密度权衡,(二) 在存档的图表内化诊断(p = 0.004 p = 0.004 p = 0.004)上取得统计上的重大收益,(三) 引用基础审计,确认80.6%的锚地或部分支持,(四) 人类验证(ob = 0.64\kappa = 0.64, 108个边缘),(五) 调查本克-集合和有约束的比较诊断,(六) 同一后端的Quen一代诊断,澄清混合概述/革命模块的作用,而不要求领导板对等。 第三,我们公布所有文物,评价脚本,注释包,再出可复制的痕迹.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Automated survey generation. Recent systems have moved from one-shot summarization toward multi-stage pipelines. AutoSurvey ( Wang et al., 2024 ) established the retrieval–outline–draft paradigm; SurveyX ( Liang et al., 2025 ) and SurveyForge ( Yan et al., 2025 ) explored stronger preprocessing, outline heuristics, and re-polishing; SciSage ( Shi et al., 2025 ) and ARISE ( Wang et al., 2025b ) introduced multi-agent and rubric-guided iterative refinement. More recent methods such as SurveyGen-I ( Chen et al., 2025 ) and SurveyGen ( Bao et al., 2025 ) further emphasize evolving plans and quality-aware retrieval.
blocks.zh: 自动勘测生成. 最近的系统已经从一发即成的总结转向多阶段的管道。 AutoSurvey(Wang等,2024年)建立了检索-出行-草案范式;SurveyX(Liang等,2025年)和SurveyForge(Yan等,2025年)探索了更强的预处理,大纲heuristics并重新作风;SciSage(Shi等,2025年)和ARISE(Wang等,2025年b)引入了多剂和卢克-指向的迭代完善. 比较新的方法,如SurveyGen-I(Chen等人,2025年)和SurveyGen(Bao等人,2025年),进一步强调不断演变的计划和质量意识检索。

blocks.en: Structure-first and agentic extensions. Several concurrent systems target structural organization. InteractiveSurvey ( Wen et al., 2025 ) supports personalized and interactive survey construction; agentic variants such as Agentic AutoSurvey ( Liu et al., 2025a ) and LLM × \times MapReduce-V2/V3 ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Chao et al., 2025 ) emphasize specialized orchestration. Among the closest concurrent works, MVSS ( Liu et al., 2026 ) aligns citation-grounded trees with survey text, while StructSurvey ( Pedinotti and Santus, 2026 ) pushes structural burden into retrieval.
blocks.zh: 结构第一和代理扩展。 若干并行系统针对的是结构组织。 InteractiveSurvey(Wen等,2025年)支持个性化和交互式调查构建;Agentic AutoSurvey(Liu等,2025年a)和LLM ×\times MapReduce-V2/V3(Wang等,2025年a;Chao等,2025年)等代理变体强调专门的管弦. 在最相近的并发作品中,MVSS(Liu等,2026年)将引用地树与勘测文本相配合,而StructSurvey(Pedinotti和Santus,2026年)将结构负担推入检索.

blocks.en: Benchmarks and evaluation. SurGE ( Su et al., 2025 ) , SGSimEval ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , SurveyBench ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , SurveyLens ( Guo et al., 2026 ) , and DeepSurvey-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) increasingly target comprehensiveness, citation accuracy, and scholarly value. Complementary work such as ReportBench ( Li et al., 2025 ) , OpenScholar ( Asai et al., 2024 ) , and iterative pairwise evaluation settings reinforce the importance of citation grounding.
blocks.zh: 基准和评价。 SurGE(Su等,2025年),SGSimEval(Guo等,2025年),Survey Bench(Sun等,2025年),SurveyLens(Guo等,2026年),和DeepSurvey-Bench(Zhang等,2026年)越来越以全面性,引用准确性,学术价值为目标. Bench报告(Li等,2025年),OpenScholar等补充工作 (Asai等人,2024年),以及迭代双向评价设置,强化了引用打地的重要性.

blocks.en: Graph-RAG and positioning. Recent graph-centric scholarly tools emphasize domain-specific literature subgraph curation and benchmarking ( Varvarigos et al., 2026 ) , document-level KG construction ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , practical GraphRAG pipelines ( Min et al., 2025 ) , and graph-guided concept selection ( Liu et al., 2025b ) . SurveyGraph differs in two ways: (1) its central representation is a method–entity evolutionary graph rather than a generic citation graph—enabling typed, auditable retrieval decisions; (2) the graph serves the entire pipeline from retrieval through outline to generation, creating a unified structural backbone.
blocks.zh: 地图 -RAG和定位。 近期以图表为中心的学术工具强调域特有文献子图的校正和基准(Varvarigos等,2026年),文件级KG构建(Zhang等,2025年),实用GraphRAG管线(Min等,2025年),和以图表指导的概念选择(Liu等,2025年b). SurveyGraph在两个方面有所不同:(1)其中心代表是一个方法-实体演化图,而不是一个通用的引用图-可以打字的,可审计的检索决定;(2)该图服务于从检索到大纲到生成的整个管道,形成统一的结构骨干.

blocks.en: 3 The SurveyGraph Framework
blocks.zh: 3 调查框架

blocks.en: SurveyGraph operates as a multi-stage pipeline designed to transform discrete paper data into coherent scientific narratives. Our methodology is structured into four stages: (1) MEKG Construction to surface field-level structure; (2) Hybrid Outline Generation to balance structural rigor with thematic discovery; (3) Graph-RAG Retrieval to retrieve graph-linked context; and (4) Evolutionary Narrative Synthesis to transform graph signals into a coherent scholarly history. Figure 1 summarizes the end-to-end workflow.
blocks.zh: SurveyGraph是一个多阶段的管道,旨在将离散的纸上数据转化为连贯的科学叙述. 我们的方法分为四个阶段: (1) MEKG 构造到地表实地结构;(2) 混合提纲生成以平衡结构强度与专题发现;(3) 图-RAG检索以检索与图表相联的上下文;和(4) 演化式叙述式合成以将图表信号转化为连贯的学术历史。 图1汇总了端到端的工作流程。

blocks.en: 3.1 Stage 1: MEKG Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 第一阶段:MEKG建设

blocks.en: To build an operational graph approximation of method-level structure, we construct the Methods-Entity Knowledge Graph (MEKG) . MEKG is formally defined as G = ( V , E ) G=(V,E) , where V V contains heterogeneous entities ( Method , Task , Dataset , Metric , Model , Innovation ) and E E comprises 21 typed relations across five categories, summarized in Table 1 . Table 1 describes the intended schema; the verified archived runs analyzed in this paper expose only a subset of these relation families in saved artifacts, so all empirical retrieval analyses below are restricted to relation types actually present in the local outputs.
blocks.zh: 为了构建一个方法层面结构的实用图近似,我们构建了方法实体知识图。 MEKG正式被定义为G = (V, E) G = (V, E),其中V包含多种实体(方法,任务,数据集,量子,模型,创新)和E E由21个类型关系组成,共分五类,汇总于表1. 表1说明了计划计划;本文中分析的经核实的存档运行只暴露出这些被保存文物中的一部分关系家族,因此以下所有经验检索分析都仅限于当地产出中实际存在的关系类型.

blocks.en: We distinguish between key semantic relations to surface follow-on links between paper records . Specifically, extends denotes a methodological follow-on relation, improves denotes a performance-oriented refinement, and applies denotes a transfer of a method or paradigm to a new task/domain. These labels are inferred from paper metadata, extracted text, and relation evidence through a multi-layer inference engine; they are validated through the semantic-edge protocol described in Section 5 . For entity resolution, we leverage scholarly metadata for papers and authors while resolving methodological entities that are often absent from generic academic knowledge graphs. In the repository implementation, upstream paper merging also applies a lightweight title normalization pass (lowercasing, punctuation stripping, and whitespace collapsing) before title-hash deduplication, so obvious cross-source aliases are filtered before MEKG construction.
blocks.zh: 我们区分纸质记录与表面后续联系的关键语义关系。 具体来说,扩展表示方法的后续关系,改进表示注重业绩的改进,并应用表示将方法或范式转移到新的任务/领域。 这些标签通过多层推论引擎从纸质元数据,取出文本,以及关系证据中推断出来;它们通过第5节所描述的语义尖端协议被验证. 为了解决实体问题,我们利用学术元数据编写论文和作者,同时解决一般学术知识图中往往没有的方法实体。 在寄存器执行中,上游相纸合并在标题-hash分解前还应用了轻量级标题正常化通关(低分解,平分分分解和白空间倒塌),因此在MEKG构建前会过滤出明显的跨源别名.

blocks.en: Figure 1: The SurveyGraph pipeline. Starting from a user-specified topic, the system constructs a Methods-Entity Knowledge Graph through multi-source collection and four-layer relation inference, then uses the graph for core-paper selection, hybrid outline generation, graph-aware retrieval, and evolutionary narrative synthesis.
blocks.zh: 图1:勘测通道。 从用户指定的主题开始,系统通过多源集和四层关系推论构建出"方法-实体知识图",再用该图进行核心文件选择,混合大纲生成,图感检索,并进行演化的叙事综合.

blocks.en: Our pipeline constructs the MEKG via a four-layer hybrid inference engine. Structural Verification establishes the graph backbone using bibliometric data; Contextual Pattern Matching identifies explicit relations in citation contexts; Shared Entity Analysis links conceptually related papers through extracted entities; and LLM Deep Reasoning proposes implicit relationships that require broader scholarly context. The relation prompt returns a typed edge, confidence, and rationale from two paper records, and the design allows a none outcome when only topical similarity is evident; Appendix K gives the template and Appendix C reports validation audits. Semantic edges are thus treated downstream as confidence-weighted links that can be filtered through the evidence gate described in Section 5 .
blocks.zh: 我们的管道通过一个四层混合推论引擎来建造MEKG. 结构核查利用生物计量数据建立图表主干线; 背景模式匹配在引用语境中识别出明确的关系; 共享实体分析通过被提取的实体将概念相关论文链接; LLM Deep Reasoning提出需要更广泛的学术背景的隐含关系. 关系提示从两个纸质记录中返回一个打入的边缘,置信度和理由,当只有主题相似性明显时,设计允许无结果;附录K给出模板和附录C报告验证审计. 因此,语义边缘在下游被视为可被过滤出第5节所描述的证据门的置信加权链接。

blocks.en: To improve robustness across models with different context windows, the implementation adaptively selects between direct full-text analysis and a Recursive Snowball Chunking strategy that processes overlapping segments while carrying forward structured summaries.
blocks.zh: 为提高具有不同上下文窗口的模型之间的稳健性,执行工作在直接全文分析和递归性雪球春金战略之间进行了适应性选择,这些战略在推进结构化摘要的同时处理重叠部分。

blocks.en: 3.2 Stage 2: Hybrid Outline Generation
blocks.zh: 3.2 阶段2:混合提纲生成

blocks.en: The goal of this stage is to establish a survey structure that is both academically rigorous and grounded in the actual data distribution of the field. We fuse a top-down survey template with bottom-up themes discovered through HDBSCAN clustering on paper embeddings. The current implementation uses title+abstract embeddings from the HuggingFace fallback stack, L2-normalizes them, clusters with HDBSCAN using min_cluster_size = 3 \texttt{min\_cluster\_size}=3 and min_samples = 2 \texttt{min\_samples}=2 (both adaptively raised with sample count), and falls back to KMeans when HDBSCAN is unavailable; an LLM-based structural architect then merges the clusters into a three-level hierarchy (section → \rightarrow subsection → \rightarrow subsubsection).
blocks.zh: 这一阶段的目标是建立一个既严格学术又以实地实际数据分布为基础的调查结构。 我们把一个自上而下的调查模板与通过HDBSCAN集群在纸上嵌入而发现的自下而上的主题结合在一起。 当前执行使用从HuggingFace倒置堆栈嵌入的标题+抽象,L2-正态化,HDBSCAN使用min_cluster_size = 3\textt{min\_ Cluster = 3和min_ samples = 2\text{ samples}=2(两者都随样本计数而适应地被提升)与HDBSCAN相接回KMEans;基于LLM的结构架构师再将集群合并为三级分级(section =\\rightarrow分节=\\rightarrow分节分节).

blocks.en: 3.3 Stage 3: Graph-RAG Retrieval
blocks.zh: 3.3 第3阶段:图-RAG 检索

blocks.en: To overcome the structural blindness of flat RAG, Graph-RAG traverses the MEKG topology to retrieve graph-linked context for each section. For a target section, the system identifies core papers and expands the context window through predecessor, successor, and sibling relations. The current implementation uses a 1-hop traversal strategy with a retrieval budget of k = 5 k=5 papers per relation type, ranked by a hybrid score of MEKG centrality, category/subcategory overlap, and the same title+abstract embedding backbone used for clustering.
blocks.zh: 为了克服平面RAG的结构失明,Graph-RAG穿越了MEKG的地貌来检索每个部分的图相上下文. 对于目标部分,该系统通过前身、后继和兄弟关系确定核心文件并扩展上下文窗口。 当前实施采用1-hop traversal策略,每个关系类型检索预算为k=5克=5相纸,按MEKG中心分数,类别/子类相重叠的混合分数排名,同名+抽象嵌入主干线用于集群.

blocks.en: Context windows are populated with topologically relevant papers: Predecessors (papers the current work extends / improves ), Successors (papers that build upon the current work), and Siblings (papers sharing method / task / dataset ). Our post-hoc depth sweep in Appendix C shows that 2-hop expansion increases relation density but lowers community coverage and unique-paper yield while traversing far more edges, so the current default remains 1-hop with adaptive pruning when the context window grows too large.
blocks.zh: 上下文窗口有与地形相关的文件: 预接器(纸张当前工作延伸/改进),后继器(以当前工作为基础的纸张)和兄弟会(纸张共享方法/任务/数据集). 我们在附录 C 中的后热深度扫描显示,2-hop扩展会增加关系密度,但会降低社区覆盖度和独特纸张产量,同时移动的边缘要多得多,所以当上下文窗口增长过大时,当前默认值仍然是1-hop,并带有适应性穿行.

blocks.en: 3.4 Stage 4: Evolutionary Narrative Synthesis
blocks.zh: 3.4 第4阶段:演化叙述综合

blocks.en: The final stage transforms structured graph signals and retrieved contexts into evolution-aware prose. An evolutionary narrative analyzer identifies likely milestones and phase transitions, then organizes them into a chronological and logical survey narrative. The implementation follows a five-stage process: (1) statistics over temporal distribution, (2) milestone identification, (3) phase analysis, (4) trend analysis, and (5) final narrative generation.
blocks.zh: 最终阶段将结构化的图示信号并检索到上下文为有进化意识的道具. 演化叙述分析器确定可能的里程碑和相位过渡,再将它们组织成时间顺序和逻辑的调查叙述. 实施工作遵循一个分五个阶段的过程:(1) 统计超过时间分布,(2) 里程碑识别,(3) 阶段分析,(4) 趋势分析,和(5) 最后叙述生成。

blocks.en: Each section undergoes a multi-stage refinement process using write–evaluate–refine loops (Algorithm 1 ). A section-level reflection agent assesses coverage and coherence. For rich media, the system uses data-template separation : LLMs extract structured JSON-like data, which is rendered with pre-defined TikZ/ L a T e X templates. This design improves render-time validation and reduces prompt fragility compared with directly asking the generator to emit finished figures.
blocks.zh: 每个区段都经过一个多阶段的完善过程,使用writ-value-refine rounds (Algorithm 1 ). 科级反射剂评估覆盖范围和一致性。 对于富媒体,系统使用数据-同时分取: LLMS提取结构化的JSON类数据,这种数据用预定义的TikZ/L a T e X模板来渲染. 这种设计改进了渲染时间的验证,与直接要求生成器发出完成的数字相比,降低了迅速的脆弱性.

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation Framework
blocks.zh: 4 评价框架

blocks.en: We design a multi-level evaluation framework that separates graph-native diagnostics, retrieval benchmarks, grounding audits, and benchmark alignment.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了一个多层次的评价框架,将图表内在的诊断,检索基准,地基审计和基准相统一分开.

blocks.en: 4.2 Benchmark Alignment
blocks.zh: 4.2 基准调整

blocks.en: We align our evaluation with metrics emphasized by SurGE ( Su et al., 2025 ) , SurveyBench ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , SurveyLens ( Guo et al., 2026 ) , DeepSurvey-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and ReportBench ( Li et al., 2025 ) . Our citation grounding audits address citation support and section–reference alignment, two dimensions represented across these benchmarks. The repository’s internal evaluator (Appendix E ) provides additional quality assurance across five dimensions.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价与SurGE(Su等,2025年),Survey Bench(Sun等,2025年),SurveyLens(Guo等,2026年),DeepSurvey-Bench(Zhang等,2026年)和Sport Bench(Li等,2025年)强调的衡量标准相一致。 我们的引文基础审计涉及引文支持和部分参考统一,这两个方面代表了这些基准。 储存库的内部评价员(附录E)在五个方面提供了额外的质量保证。

blocks.en: 5 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5. 评价

blocks.en: We organize our evaluation around five research questions: RQ1 : Does MEKG-based retrieval provide measurable advantages over flat and graph-free baselines? RQ2 : How does typed MEKG retrieval compare against lightweight graph alternatives in a controlled equal-budget benchmark? RQ3 : Can semantic-edge quality be validated, and does evidence-based filtering improve retrieval? RQ4 : Are generated survey citations well-grounded in source evidence? RQ5 : Under a fixed backend and reused MEKG substrate, how do generation-stage controls affect inspectable survey artifacts?
blocks.zh: 我们围绕五个研究问题组织评估: RQ1 : (韩语). 基于MEKG的检索是否比平面和无图表基线提供了可衡量的优势? RQ2 : (英语). 在受控的等预算基准中,如何将MEKG检索与轻量级图表替代品进行比较? RQ3 : (中文(简体) ). 语义尖端的质量能否被验证,以证据为基础的过滤是否改善了检索? 问题4: 生成的调查引用是否以来源证据为依据? 第5个问题: 在固定后端和再利用的MEKG基质下,生成阶段的控制如何影响可检查的勘测文物?

blocks.en: 5.1 Evaluation Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 评价设置

blocks.en: Our evaluation covers eight completed SurveyGraph runs spanning seven topic labels: LLM function calling, document visual question answering, memory in AI agents, city-airspace embodied QA (two independent runs), Text-to-SQL agents, document question answering, and general agents. A focused same-backend generation-diagnostic batch uses LLM function calling. We conduct a seven-method equal-budget retrieval benchmark (Table 2 ), semantic-edge validation with adjudicated human annotation, citation-grounding audits at claim and section levels, four artifact-backed Qwen component diagnostics, and one matched flat generation run on the same 30-paper corpus. Retrieval methods share identical section queries and top- 5 5 budgets. Appendix A lists every archived run; Appendix B.3 maps the generation diagnostics to their artifacts.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价涵盖8个已完成的 " 调查 " 项目,涉及7个主题: LLM函数调用,文档可视问题回答,AI代理中的内存,城市-空气空间已包含QA(两个独立运行),Text-to-SQL代理,文档问题回答,以及一般代理. 焦点同后端生成-诊断批量使用LLM函数调用. 我们进行7个方法的同等预算检索基准(表2),语义尖端验证,并作出裁定的人类注释,在索赔和部门一级进行引用依据审计,4个人工支持的Quen组件诊断,以及一个对应的平方一代在同一30个文件目录上运行。 检索方法共享相同的款次查询和前5个预算。 附 录 A列出每个存档跑;附录B.3将生成诊断图绘制在他们的文物上.

blocks.en: 5.2 Graph-Aware Retrieval (RQ1)
blocks.zh: 5.2 图-软件检索(RQ1)

blocks.en: We compare graph-aware retrieval (incorporating category overlap, PageRank centrality, and 1-hop relation expansion) against flat lexical retrieval across eight runs under a fixed top- 5 5 per-section budget. Each run constructs a MEKG with 2,136–2,504 relations over 143 papers on average.
blocks.zh: 我们把图感检索(包括类别重叠、PageRank中心化和1-hop关系扩展)与8个领域的平面词典检索相比较,在一个固定的每款预算5个上下。 每次运行都会建造一个MEKG,平均比143个文件有2,136–2,504个关系.

blocks.en: On the archived graph-native target set, graph-aware retrieval nearly doubles core-paper recall (0.373 vs. 0.216) with consistent gains across all runs (sign test p = 0.004 p{=}0.004 ). Relation density improves substantially (0.259 vs. 0.162), and community coverage rises from 0.758 to 0.863. A signal-component ablation confirms that graph-neighborhood traversal is the primary driver: removing 1-hop expansion collapses recall to 0.219, while removing PageRank centrality has a smaller effect (recall drops to 0.341). We therefore treat this result as a mechanism diagnostic; the external-proxy benchmark below tests transfer beyond graph-derived targets.
blocks.zh: 在存档的图表内在目标集上,图感检索几乎是核心纸张召回的两倍(0.373对0.216),并且在所有各行各业都取得了一致的收益(签名测试p=0.004 p=0.004)。 关系密度大幅提高(0.259对0.162),社区覆盖率从0.758提高到0.863. 信号-元件通缩确认图-相邻通缩为主驱动:去除1-hop通缩回0.219,去除PageRank中心作用较小(回缩为0.341). 因此,我们把这一结果视为一种机制诊断;在测试之后的外部代用基准转移超出图表衍生目标。

blocks.en: The gain is robust to confidence thresholds: retaining only high-confidence edges ( ≥ \geq 0.9, representing 39% of all edges) still yields recall of 0.342, indicating that the most confident edges carry most of the retrieval signal. Budget sweeps at top-3/5/7 all show consistent advantages.
blocks.zh: 增益为自信心阈值:只保留高自信边缘(\\ geq 0.9,占所有边值的39%)仍能回想0.342,表明最自信的边缘携带了大部分回取信号. 预算扫描在前3/5/7都显示出一贯的优势。

blocks.en: To reduce circularity, we also evaluate against an external proxy built from papers cited in local survey documents but not selected by the MEKG core scorer. In a separate top- 20 20 leave-one-run-out core-score calibration, external-proxy recall reaches 0.289; this setting is distinct from the top- 5 5 equal-budget benchmark below, where typed MEKG alone reaches 0.153. The calibration remains topic-sensitive and is evidence that the score can be tuned against an external signal, not a claim that typed retrieval maximizes raw recall.
blocks.zh: 为了减少循环性,我们还对照根据当地调查文件所引用的、但未由MEKG核心计分员选择的论文所建立的一个外部代理来评价。 在单独的前20名中,20名留置一跑出的核心分数校准中,外置代用回调达到0.289;这种设置不同于下方的前5名5名平预算基准,单打MEKG就达到0.153. 校正仍然对话题敏感,是可以被调取分数与外部信号相适应的证据,而不是打出检索可以使原始回想最大化的说法.

blocks.en: 5.3 Equal-Budget Retrieval Benchmark (RQ2)
blocks.zh: 5.3 平等预算检索基准(RQ2)

blocks.en: To contextualize MEKG against strong baselines, we conduct a seven-method benchmark under identical conditions (Table 2 ). The “MEKG typed” row isolates typed-edge traversal alone (without the full graph-aware scoring from RQ1 that adds PageRank and 1-hop expansion); fusion rows show how combining both signals recovers and exceeds flat-retrieval recall.
blocks.zh: 为了使MEKG与强基线相对应,我们在相同条件下实行七方方法基准(表2)。 “MEKG打入”行单独隔离打入的尖端转录(没有从RQ1中添加PageRank和1-hop扩展的全图感分数); 聚变行显示两个信号的组合如何恢复和超过平复回.

blocks.en: Table 2: Seven-method equal-budget retrieval benchmark (top- 5 5 ). Str. =section-evidence alignment; Den. =typed relation density; CoCit =co-citation connectivity (fraction of retrieved pairs sharing ≥ \geq 1 common citing paper via OpenAlex, independent of MEKG).
blocks.zh: 表2:七法平预算检索基准(上-5 5 . Str. = section-evidence 校正; Den. = 类型关系密度; CoCit = 共引用连接(被取回的对共享\\\ geq 1 常见引用纸张通过OpenAlex,独立于MEKG).

blocks.en: The results reveal a complementarity pattern. Graph-free methods achieve higher raw recall but minimal typed structure (density ≤ \leq 0.140). MEKG retrieval yields the densest neighborhoods but lower surface recall alone. Fusion methods outperform either in isolation : MEKG-anchored fusion nearly doubles relation density while maintaining competitive recall. The MEKG-independent co-citation metric (CoCit) confirms that MEKG-linked methods produce retrieved sets with higher co-citation connectivity (0.147–0.163 vs. 0.089–0.131), indicating genuine bibliometric relationships rather than artifacts of MEKG’s own edge definitions. An encoder-sensitivity analysis across five rankers (BM25, Sentence-BERT ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ) , BGE, GTE, and E5) confirms that anchor-preserving fusion is the robust default: all encoders show the same complementarity pattern, with fusion consistently outperforming either signal alone regardless of the underlying embedding model.
blocks.zh: 结果显示出一种互补性模式。 无图法可以实现更高的原始召回,但最少打出的结构(密度为 \\\leq 0.140)。 MEKG检索产生密度最高的邻里,但单靠较低的地表回溯. 融合方法在孤立状态下都优于业绩: MEKG-受干扰的聚变几乎是关系密度的两倍,同时保持竞争性召回. MEKG-独立引用指标(CoCit)证实,MEKG-链接方法生成了具有较高引用连通性的检索集(0.147-0.163对0.089-0.131),表明真实的比喻关系而不是MEKG自身边缘定义的文物. 对五个分级器(BM25,Priment-BERT (Reimers and Gurevych, 2019)),BGE,GTE,和E5)的编码灵敏度分析证实:锚地-保定聚变是强势的默认:所有编码器都显示相同的互补模式,无论嵌入模式如何,核聚变都始终比两个信号都强.

blocks.en: 5.4 Semantic-Edge Validation (RQ3)
blocks.zh: 5.4 语义学-词典验证(RQ3)

blocks.en: We validate MEKG semantic edges through consistency audits, evidence-gated retrieval, and adjudicated human annotation.
blocks.zh: 我们通过一致性审计、证据检索和人类注释来验证MEKG语义学的边缘。

blocks.en: Consistency and negative controls. Across 2,091 semantic edges ( extends : 1,276; improves : 366; applies : 449), temporal direction consistency exceeds 98% for all types. A deterministic evidence protocol examines lexical overlap between source/target paper metadata and labels each edge as supported, partial, or unsupported. Overall, 58.8% are supported-or-partial, with improves strongest (80.6%), applies at 59.0%, and extends weakest (52.4%)—reflecting that “extends” relations are often implicit and harder to validate from surface features alone. Negative-control analysis confirms clear separability from random non-edges ( p = 0.004 p{=}0.004 ). A matched-control analysis further shows that extends and improves are above matched baselines, while applies is near baseline—indicating that the pipeline is better at detecting methodological refinement than cross-domain transfer.
blocks.zh: 一致性和负控. 在2,091个语义边缘上(延伸:1,276;改进:366;适用:449),时间方向一致性在所有类型上都超过98%. 确定性证据协议审查源/目标纸元数据之间的词汇重叠,并将每个边缘作为支持、部分或不支持的标签。 总的来说,58.8%是支持或部分支持的,改善幅度最大(80.6%),适用率为59.0%,扩展幅度最弱(52.4%),反映出 " 扩展 " 关系往往含蓄,更难仅从表面特征中验证。 负控制分析确认从随机非对接物(p = 0.004 p = 0.004)可明显分离. 匹配控制分析进一步表明,扩展和改进高于匹配基线,而适用接近基线——表明管道比跨域转让更能发现方法上的改进。

blocks.en: Evidence-gated retrieval. Converting protocol labels into a retrieval gate provides a controlled non-degradation diagnostic: the gate removes approximately 103 noisy semantic candidates per topic while changing mean recall from 0.164 to 0.182 and precision from 0.105 to 0.117. Per topic, recall improves only on Memory in the Age of AI Agents ( + 0.071 +0.071 ) and is exactly unchanged on the other three topics at stored precision; precision improves on two topics and exactly ties on two, with no declines. Removing candidates can improve top- 5 5 recall because unsupported semantic edges may place noisy papers in the highest-ranked slots; filtering them allows an external-proxy target to enter the fixed top- 5 5 set. Given four topics, we interpret the mean gains descriptively rather than as statistical superiority. A target-role pruning heuristic further removes 10% of semantically misclassified edges with no retrieval degradation. A ROC-style analysis over the 108 annotated edges (Figure A.1 in Appendix) yields AUC=0.75, with the optimal confidence threshold at 0.35 achieving F1=0.81. Per-type analysis reveals that improves and applies are well-separated (F1 > > 0.88) while extends requires a higher threshold for acceptable precision.
blocks.zh: 取证取出. 将协议标签转换为取回门提供受控的非降解诊断:门将每个话题去除大约103个吵闹的语义考生,同时将中调从0.164改为0.182,精度从0.105改为0.117. 每个话题,回想仅在AI代理时代的记忆上有所改进(+0.071+0.071),其他三个话题在存储精度上完全不变;精度在两个话题上有所改进,在两个话题上完全关联,没有下降. 删除考生可以改善上-5 5回想,因为没有支持的语义边缘可能会将吵闹的论文放入排位最高的档位;过滤后可以让外置代用目标进入固定上-5 5套. 从四个主题来看,我们对平均收益的解释是描述性的,而不是统计优势。 一个目标作用平流热能进一步去除10%的分级错误边缘而无回取降解. 对108个注解边缘(附录图A.1)的ROC式分析得出AUC=0.75,最佳置信阈值为0.35,实现F1=0.81. 按类型进行的分析表明,改进和应用是分开的(F1 > > 0.88),而扩展则要求更高的阈值,以达到可接受的精度。

blocks.en: Human validation. Two graduate-student annotators independently labeled the full 108-row stratified annotation packet (three relation types × \times three confidence tiers × \times 12 edges per cell) following detailed guidelines with worked examples. Each row includes source/target paper context, the inferred relation with confidence, and a matched non-edge control. Annotators assigned ternary labels: supported , partial , or unsupported .
blocks.zh: 人文验证. 两个研究生的注释员独立地将完整的108行分层的注释包(三个关系类型 ×\times 3个信任级 ×\times 12 edges / cell)贴上标签,按照工作实例的详细准则. 每行包括源/目标纸张上下文、有自信的推断关系和相匹配的非对角控制。 注释者指定了三重标签:支持、部分或不支持。

blocks.en: Inter-annotator agreement reaches Cohen’s κ = 0.64 \kappa{=}0.64 (substantial) for the binary supported-or-partial versus unsupported decision; three-way agreement is lower ( κ = 0.38 \kappa{=}0.38 ), so we use ternary labels primarily for failure-mode diagnosis rather than as a calibrated ordinal scale. After adjudication of 45 disagreement cases by a third annotator, the final consensus labels show 68.5% supported-or-partial overall (fully supported: 40.7%; partial: 27.8%; unsupported: 31.5%). Partial edges retain correct directionality and semantic relevance but lack complete lexical evidence—the evidence gate (Section 3.1 ) is specifically designed to filter these into usable versus noisy subsets. By relation type: improves is strongest at 80.6%, applies reaches 72.2%, and extends is weakest at 52.8%—consistent with the deterministic protocol’s ranking. By confidence tier: high-confidence edges reach 75.0% supported-or-partial, mid-confidence 72.2%, and low-confidence 58.3%, confirming that the pipeline’s confidence score is a meaningful quality signal. We release the full annotation packet with adjudicated labels and guidelines.
blocks.zh: 在二进制支持或部分与非支持的决定上, 注释者之间的协议达到了 Cohen = 0. 64\kappa = 0. 64(实质) ; 三方协议较低( = 0. 38\kappa = 0.38) , 所以我们主要使用三进制标签来进行故障模式诊断, 而不是作为校正的平面尺度 。 在第三个注释者裁定了45起分歧案件之后,最终共识标签显示,总体支持率为68.5%(完全支持:40.7%;部分支持:27.8%;不支持:31.5%)。 部分边缘保留了正确的方向性和语义相关性,但缺乏完整的词典证据——证据门(第3.1节)是专门设计的,用来将证据门过滤成可用子集,而不是噪音子集。 按关系类型划分:改善幅度最大,为80.6%,应用率达到72.2%,扩展幅度最弱,为52.8+================================================================================================================================================================================================================================== 根据信心等级:高自信边缘达到75.0%的支持率或公正性,中自信为72.2%,而低自信为58.3%,这证实了管道信心分数是一个有意义的质量信号。 我们发布了完整的注解包 附有裁定的标签和准则。

blocks.en: 5.5 Citation Grounding Audits (RQ4)
blocks.zh: 5.5 引用依据审计(RQ4)

blocks.en: Claim-level anchoring. We sample 20 cited sentences per run from eight generated surveys (160 total), stratified across single- and multi-citation cases. Each sentence is compared against cited paper titles, abstracts, and cached text using lexical overlap measures. The audit finds 93 anchored, 36 partial, and 31 weak/missing cases (80.6% anchored-or-partial).
blocks.zh: 索赔一级锚定。 我们抽样抽查了8起调查(共计160起)中每起引用的20个句子,按单一和多例案例分级。 每个句子都与所引用的纸质标题、摘要和缓存文本作比较,同时使用词汇重叠计量法。 审计发现有93起锚定案、36起部分案和31起弱/漏案(80.6%的锚定-或部分)。

blocks.en: To validate that lexical anchoring reflects genuine evidence alignment, we construct a hard-negative contrast: for each cited sentence, we compare similarity to the cited paper against a same-run non-cited paper matched on topic. Cited evidence outperforms hard negatives in 65.4% of cases, with anchored sentences at 71.7% and weak cases near chance (48.4%). This gradient confirms that the lexical audit captures real grounding quality.
blocks.zh: 为了证实词汇定位反映了真正的证据一致性,我们构建了一个硬反向对比:对于所引用的每一个句子,我们比较了与所引用的论文相似的同运行的非引用论文在主题上相匹配. 援引的证据在65.4%的案件中表现优于硬负数,固定判决为71.7%,薄弱案件接近概率(48.4%)。 这一梯度证实,语法审计掌握了真正的基础质量。

blocks.en: Section-level alignment. A 42-section audit across all eight runs shows zero uncited sections, with 85.7% achieving aligned-or-partial status and mean citation density of 19.5 citations per section.
blocks.zh: 科级对接. 对所有八行进行的42节审计显示,未引用部分为零,85.7%达到对齐或部分状态,平均引用密度为每节19.5次。

blocks.en: 5.6 Baseline Comparisons
blocks.zh: 5.6 基线比较

blocks.en: SurveyGraph produces substantially richer outlines than SciSage (7.25 vs. 2.75 sections on same topics), with SciSage systematically missing key structural roles such as methodology comparison and future directions. Structural comparisons against 48 released outputs from four concurrent systems are in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: SurveyGraph制作的提纲比SciSage(7.25对2.75节关于同主题)要丰富得多,而SciSage系统忽略了方法比较和未来方向等关键结构角色. 与四个并行系统的48个产出的结构比较载于附录B。

blocks.en: SurveyBench-facing probes. We do not claim full SurveyBench leaderboard parity. Instead, we report two benchmark-facing diagnostics that are fully replayable from released artifacts. First, a reference-list probe over the local SurveyForge SurveyBench snapshot gives the released SurveyForge references 0.465 mean coverage and human survey references 0.629, while topic-mismatched SurveyGraph archives overlap too weakly to support an end-to-end benchmark claim. Second, a live collection-stage probe with the repository’s enhanced collector covers four SurveyBench topics under a fixed eight-paper budget and reaches 0.521 mean reference coverage versus 0.166 for exact-topic retrieval on the same topics. These probes show benchmark-facing collection viability, but they do not test outlining, long-form generation, or claim support. Full details appear in Appendix H . Separately, a same-backend pipeline-completion audit runs the full collection–MEKG–outline–generation–PDF path on five topics with Qwen-2.5 and a fixed 30-paper budget; all five complete, with 31–202 typed relations and 7–8 generated sections (Appendix B.4 ). This audit supports cross-topic pipeline execution, not SurveyBench leaderboard parity or long-form quality superiority.
blocks.zh: 勘测奔驰探测器. 我们并不要求完全的 调查本奇领导板对等。 相反,我们报告了两个基准诊断,这些诊断完全可以从释放的文物中重现。 首先,对本地SurveyForge Survey Bench快照的参考清单调查给出了发布的SurveyForge参考文献0.465平均覆盖范围和人类调查参考文献0.629,而主题相匹配的SurveyGraph档案重叠太弱,无法支持端到端的基准索赔. 第二,一个现场收集阶段探测器与存储库的强化收集器一起,在固定的八纸预算中涵盖四个 " 调查奔驰 " 专题,并达到0.521平均参考范围,而同一专题的确切专题检索则为0.166。 这些探测器显示有制定基准的收集可行性,但没有测试概述、长式生成或索赔支持。 详情见附录H。 另外,一个同后端管道-完成审计在五个专题上运行了完整的收集-MEKG-outline-generation-PDF路径,其中Quen-2.5和固定的30个文件预算;所有五个项目已经完成,有31-202个类型关系和7-8个生成的款(附录B.4)。 这项审计支持跨专题的管道执行,而不是Survey Bench领导板对等或长式质量优势.

blocks.en: Comparison with concurrent systems. We use MVSS ( Liu et al., 2026 ) and StructSurvey ( Pedinotti and Santus, 2026 ) as closest structure-first points of comparison, but we do not present the current comparison as a same-backend live rerun. The available evidence is bounded: released numbers, inspectable artifacts, and our own relation-diversity diagnostics indicate that SurveyGraph’s distinctive contribution is the typed semantic layer and its evidence gate, not an uncontested end-to-end quality win. We therefore use these systems to contextualize the design space and to motivate typed diagnostics; full same-topic, same-budget, same-backend cross-system generation parity remains future work.
blocks.zh: 与并行系统的比较。 我们使用MVSS(Liu等,2026年)和StructSurvey(Pedinotti和Santus,2026年)作为最接近的结构-第一比较点,但我们并没有将目前的比较作为同后端活地重播. 现有的证据是有限度的:公布的数字,可检查的文物,我们自己的关系多样性诊断表明,SurveyGraph的独特贡献是打字语义层及其证据门,而不是无可争议的端到端质量取胜。 因此,我们利用这些系统来调整设计空间的背景,并激励打字诊断;完全相同的专题、相同的预算、相同的后端跨系统生成均等仍然是今后的工作。

blocks.en: 5.7 Generation-Stage Controlled Diagnostics (RQ5)
blocks.zh: 5.7 世代控制诊断(RQ5)

blocks.en: To separate backend confounds from retrieval-stage evidence within a bounded API budget, we ran a same-backend Qwen diagnostic batch on the topic Large Language Model Function Calling . The full run built a 30-paper MEKG with 74 typed relations; the controlled diagnostics reused this substrate where possible and disabled external multi-judge evaluation, AI image generation, and optional critical-analysis LLM paragraph rewriting. Table 3 reports the artifact-backed component results. We also completed a matched flat generation run that fixes the same 30-paper corpus, Qwen backend, top-down outline, and generation/reflection settings while removing MEKG relations and graph-derived attributes.
blocks.zh: 为了在 API 预算范围内将后端错误与检索阶段证据区分开来, 我们运行了一个相同的后端 Quen 诊断批次, 全跑会搭建了有74个打字关系的30相纸MEKG;被控制的诊断器尽可能地再利用了这个底片,并禁用外部多判断评价,AI图像生成,以及可选的批判分析LLM段落重写. 表3报告由文物支撑的构成部分结果。 我们还完成了一个匹配的平地生成运行,在消除MEKG关系和图出属性的同时,修正了相同的30相纸体,Quen后端,自上而下大纲,以及生成/折射设置.

blocks.en: Table 3: Same-backend generation-stage controlled diagnostics on one Qwen topic. Values are reported for the archived diagnostic batch described in Appendix B.3 . MEKG is the internal graph-native overall score; Global is the global-reflection score. These diagnostics support bounded component analysis rather than a leaderboard claim or cross-system superiority statement.
blocks.zh: 表3:一个Quen主题上的同后端生成相控诊断. 附录B.3所述存档诊断批次的数值报告。 MEKG是内部的图表本土整体分数;Global是全球反射分数. 这些诊断支持受约束的成分分析,而不是领导板主张或跨系统优越性声明.

blocks.en: The diagnostic pattern is informative but deliberately not overinterpreted. The full run and no-critic/no-refine run both remain in the “good” rubric band, suggesting that the MEKG substrate and reflective content generator provide much of the artifact quality under this topic. Disabling the evolutionary analyzer mainly lowers the global-reflection score (3.80 to 3.50), indicating that the evolutionary narrative contributes to consistency checks more than to the internal graph metrics in this controlled setting. The no-hybrid outline run completes successfully but shifts to a simpler five-section organization and lower rubric/global-reflection scores. This directly supports the design choice to keep hybrid outline generation as the default while exposing a reproducible fallback path when the LLM outline call fails.
blocks.zh: 诊断模式内容丰富,但刻意没有过分解释。 全部运行和无批评/无反射运行都留在“好”栏下,这表明MEKG底盘和反射内容生成器提供了这一主题下的大部分文物质量。 使演化分析器失效,主要降低全局反射分数(3.80分到3.50分),表明演化叙事比起这个被控制的设置中内部的图度量,更有助于一致性检查. 无韵母大纲运行成功,但转向更简单的五节编组和更低的分数/全球反射分数. 这直接支持设计选择,在LLM大纲调用失败时,将混合大纲生成保留为默认,同时暴露出可复制倒回路径.

blocks.en: Table 4: Matched generation diagnostic on one Qwen topic. Both conditions use the same 30 papers, backend, outline, and generation/reflection settings; the flat condition removes MEKG relations and graph-derived attributes. Grounding and alignment use the complete enhanced survey bodies.
blocks.zh: 表4:一个Quen专题的匹配生成诊断. 这两个条件都使用相同的30个相纸,后端,大纲,以及生成/反演设置;平面条件去除MEKG关系和图出属性. 定位和调整使用完整的强化调查机构。

blocks.en: The matched result improves the local rubric, global reflection, and citation grounding. Section alignment is 3/4 versus 3/5: the numerator is identical and the eligible-section denominator differs by one, so this row is treated only as directional evidence. Neither condition has an uncited eligible section. The evidence-level TF–IDF hard-negative contrast instead favors flat generation (65.5% vs. 78.4%). We therefore do not claim universal metric dominance. The controlled evidence supports a narrower mechanism: MEKG improves structural evidence organization and grounding, while generic lexical similarity can favor the flatter output.
blocks.zh: 相应的结果改进了地方标题、全球反思和引文定位。 分节对接为3/4对3/5:分数相同,合格分分母各有不同,因此本行只作为方向证据来对待. 两个条件都不符合规定。 证据层面的TF–IDF硬负对比偏好平地生成(65.5%对78.4%). 因此,我们并不主张普遍的标准支配地位。 受控制的证据支持一个较窄的机制: MEKG改进了结构证据组织和地基,而通用词典的相似性可以偏向于受宠产出.

blocks.en: 5.8 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5.8 讨论情况

blocks.en: The seven-method benchmark reveals a complementarity pattern: typed MEKG retrieval does not dominate graph-free methods on surface recall, but provides typed relations that explain retrieval decisions, enable evidence-based filtering, and support safer fusion that boosts structural density without sacrificing recall. The CoCit metric confirms these gains reflect genuine bibliometric relationships rather than artifacts of the graph’s own edge definitions.
blocks.zh: 七法基准揭示了一种互补模式:打入的MEKG检索在地表召回上并不主导无图法,而是提供打出的关系,解释取回决定,使基于证据的过滤成为可能,并支持更安全的聚变,在不牺牲召回的情况下提高结构密度. CoCit 度量表证实了这些收益反映了真实的两相关系,而不是图本身边缘定义的文物。

blocks.en: Figure 3: MEKG-driven evolutionary structure: the graph captures method-level follow-on, competition, and shared-resource relations, enabling the narrative synthesizer to trace research lineages.
blocks.zh: 图3:MEKG驱动的演化结构:图能捕捉到方法层面的后续,竞争,以及共享资源关系,使叙事合成器能够追踪研究行.

blocks.en: Beyond retrieval, MEKG structure directly informs outline generation—graph-aware outlines average 7.25 sections with 36.5 nodes vs. 2.75 sections from SciSage on the same topics. The SurveyBench-facing collection probes show that the collector can recover benchmark references, while the retrieval and signal-component ablations isolate where the strongest evidence currently lies. In particular, removing 1-hop expansion collapses recall to near-flat levels, while removing PageRank centrality has a smaller effect, suggesting that MEKG’s value lies primarily in its connectivity structure rather than in node-level features alone. The same-backend Qwen diagnostics in Tables 3 and 4 add generation-stage checks: hybrid outlines and evolutionary analysis improve artifact organization/consistency signals, but the evidence remains a bounded one-topic diagnostic rather than a broad benchmark.
blocks.zh: 除了检索之外,MEKG结构直接告知大纲生成-图感-概要平均7.25节,节点为36.5个,而SciSage的2.75节则涉及同样的主题。 Survey Bench-facing收集探测器显示,收集器可以收回基准参考文献,而检索和信号组件则将目前最有力的证据隔离出何处。 特别是,去除1-hop扩展倒塌会回升到接近平面的水平,而去除PageRank中心效应较小,说明MEKG的价值主要在于其连通结构,而不只是节点级特征. 表3和表4中同后端的Quen诊断会增加生成阶段检查:混合图和演化分析会改善文物组织/一致性信号,但证据仍然是一主题诊断,而不是宽泛的基准.

blocks.en: The concurrent-system comparison is used for positioning rather than end-to-end superiority. SurveyGraph’s distinguishing capability is relation-specific filtering: its typed semantic layer exposes separate evidence thresholds for extends , improves , and applies . The ROC analysis (Appendix I ) quantifies this precision–recall control, while MVSS and StructSurvey provide complementary structure-first designs under different evaluation settings.
blocks.zh: 同时系统比较用于定位而非端到端优势. SurveyGraph的分辨能力是针对关系的过滤:其打入的语义层暴露了扩展、改进和适用的不同证据阈值。 ROC分析(Appendix I)将这种精度-召回控制量化,而MVSS和StructSurvey则在不同的评价设置下提供互补的结构-第一设计.

blocks.en: Scalability and cost considerations. MEKG construction accounts for 55% of the pipeline’s token budget, but this cost is amortized across multiple retrieval queries, outline variants, and generation passes. Once built, a topic MEKG serves repeated survey generation at marginal cost (retrieval + synthesis only). The modular architecture supports drop-in replacement of the LLM backbone, enabling cost–quality tradeoffs without pipeline redesign. In practice, once a MEKG is constructed for a topic, it can serve multiple survey variants and incremental updates as new papers appear.
blocks.zh: 可扩展性和成本考虑。 MEKG的建造占管道象征性预算的55%,但这一费用通过多个检索查询、大纲变体和发电通行证来摊还。 一旦建成,一个主题MEKG以边际成本服务于重复的调查生成(仅检索+合成). 模块化架构支持LLM主干线的倒置取而代之,从而能够在不重新设计管道的情况下进行成本-质量取舍。 在实践中,一旦为某一主题构建了MEKG,它就能够随着新论文的出现而为多种调查变体和渐进更新服务.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We have presented SurveyGraph, a graph-centric framework for automated survey generation that uses a Methods-Entity Knowledge Graph to model method-level evolutionary structure. Our evaluation demonstrates three key findings: (1) graph-neighborhood traversal drives the gain over flat retrieval on the archived graph-native core diagnostic ( p = 0.004 p{=}0.004 ); (2) MEKG-anchored fusion provides a strong recall–structure tradeoff in a controlled seven-method benchmark, supported by an independent co-citation metric; and (3) evidence gating (AUC=0.75) filters noisy semantic candidates, with human annotation ( κ = 0.64 \kappa{=}0.64 for binary support) confirming that 68.5% of sampled edges are supported-or-partial after adjudication. SurveyBench results remain collection-stage diagnostics, and MVSS/StructSurvey remain contextual comparisons. The supported contribution is an auditable typed structural layer for safer fusion, relation-specific filtering, and controllable generation.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了SurveyGraph,这是一个以图表为中心的自动调查生成框架,它使用方法实体知识图来模拟方法层面的演化结构。 我们的评价显示了三个关键结果:(1) 图-邻向式驱动在存档的图-内核诊断(p = 0.004 p = 0.004)上的平复取回的增益;(2) MEKG-选择性聚变提供了强烈的回溯-结构取舍,在一个受控制的7-方法基准中,辅以独立的引用指标;(3) 证据gating(AUC = 0.75) 过滤有声的语义学考生,人类注释(obs = 0.64\kappa-0.64 = 二进制支持)证实68.5%的样本边缘在判决后得到支持或部分支持。 调查本奇结果仍然是收集阶段诊断,MVSS/StructSurvey仍然是背景比较. 支持的贡献是一个可审计的打字结构层,用于更安全的聚变,针对关系的过滤,以及可控制的生成.

blocks.en: These findings also define how the framework should be used. The graph is an auditable control layer: typed relations expose structural assumptions behind retrieval, and relation-specific gates prevent unsupported candidates from reaching synthesis. External co-citation and citation-grounding checks provide independent signals, while the same-backend study isolates component behavior without making a bounded diagnostic a leaderboard claim.
blocks.zh: 这些结论还确定了如何使用该框架。 图是可审核的控制层:打出的关系暴露出检索背后的结构假设,而针对关系的门能防止不支持的考生到达合成. 外部共引和引出地查提供了独立的信号,而同后端研究则隔离了组件行为,而不使有界限的诊断成为领导板主张.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our SurveyBench-facing results are collection-stage and reference-list probes rather than full end-to-end benchmark submissions (Section 5 ). They cover four enhanced-collector topics and all ten reference-list topics, but they do not yet include full outlining, writing, or claim-support evaluation on the complete SurveyBench suite, nor evaluations on SurGE or SurveyLens. We plan to complete these evaluations using the same infrastructure released with this paper.
blocks.zh: 我们的 " 调查本能 " 成果是收集阶段和参考清单调查,而不是提交完整的端到端基准(第5节)。 它们涵盖四个强化收集专题和所有十个参考清单专题,但尚未包括完整概述、撰写或对完整的Survey Bench套套件进行索赔支持评价,也未包括对SurGE或SurveyLens的评价。 我们计划利用本文件公布的基础设施完成这些评价。

blocks.en: The semantic-edge validation covers 108 stratified edges with two annotators and adjudication. While the inter-annotator agreement on the binary support decision ( κ = 0.64 \kappa{=}0.64 ) is substantial, the sample covers three relation types from a single domain cluster and the three-way label agreement is lower. The four-topic SurveyBench collection probe spans distinct AI subfields, and CoCit improvements are consistent across the archived retrieval runs, but these are indirect generalization checks rather than substitutes for a larger human edge study. Extending the annotation to additional topics and relation types would further strengthen these claims. The released annotation package is designed to enable this community effort.
blocks.zh: 语义学-尖端验证包括108个分层边缘并有2个注释和裁定. 虽然关于二进制支持决定的注释员间协议(ob = 0.64\kappa\0.64)是实质性的,但样本涵盖了单一域群的三种关系类型,而三向标签协议则较低. 由四个专题组成的"勘测本克"收集探测器横跨了不同的AI子域,而CoCit的改进在存档检索运行中是一致的,但这些是间接的泛化检查,而不是取而代之的更大的人边研究. 将说明扩大到其他专题和关系类型将进一步加强这些主张。 所发布的注释包旨在促成这一社区努力。

blocks.en: Our comparison with MVSS and StructSurvey is not a same-backend live rerun. Differences in model backbones, released artifacts, and evaluation settings introduce a confound, so we do not use these comparisons as decisive evidence of end-to-end superiority. The same-backend Qwen diagnostics in Section 5 reduce confounding for SurveyGraph’s own generation-stage choices, but they do not replace a same-topic, same-budget, same-backend rerun against MVSS or StructSurvey. The robust architectural claim is narrower: SurveyGraph exposes typed relation diversity and per-relation evidence gates that flat or citation-tree systems do not provide; full controlled cross-system generation parity remains future work.
blocks.zh: 我们与MVSS和StructSurvey的比较并不是同一后端直播重播. 模型骨干,出品文物,评价设置的差异,引入了错位,因此我们不将这些比较作为端到端优势的决定性证据. 第5节中同一后端的Quen诊断会减少SurveyGraph自己世代阶段选择的困惑,但不会取代一个同题,同预算,同后端的重跑来对抗MVSS或StructSurvey. 强健的建筑主张范围更窄:SurveyGraph暴露出平面系统或引用-树木系统不提供的打入式关系多样性和亲和性证据门;完全可控的跨系统生成等同仍然是今后的工作.

blocks.en: Finally, the graph-native metrics (WCR, CC, SC) are designed as diagnostic signals for understanding pipeline behavior rather than as standalone quality measures. We complement them with external-facing metrics (citation grounding, section alignment, evidence contrasts) that do not depend on the internal graph.
blocks.zh: 最后,图形内在度量衡(WCR,CC,SC)被设计为理解管道行为的诊断信号,而不是独立的质量度量. 我们用不取决于内部图表的外部衡量标准(引用地基、区段对齐、证据对比)来补充它们。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: SurveyGraph operates on publicly available scholarly metadata, paper text, and generated survey artifacts; we do not report experiments involving human subjects or newly collected personal data. We use only standard bibliographic information already exposed by scholarly records, and we do not release any additional person-level annotations beyond the derived experimental artifacts discussed in this paper. The main ethical risk is that automated survey generation may amplify hallucinated citations, unsupported summaries, or structurally plausible but incomplete synthesis if the graph or evaluator is incomplete. For this reason, we explicitly separate diagnostic graph metrics from benchmark-facing evaluation and avoid presenting the internal composite score as a proxy for human scholarly judgment. We also used AI assistants during code exploration and drafting support, but all reported claims were checked against archived artifacts, logs, and reproduced outputs before inclusion.
blocks.zh: SurveyGraph利用公开提供的学术元数据、纸质文本和产生的调查文物;我们不报告涉及人类主体或新收集的个人数据的实验。 我们只使用学术记录已经暴露出的标准书目资料,除了本文所讨论出的一些实验文物外,我们不发布任何其他的人级说明。 主要的道德风险是,如果图表或评估者不完整,自动调查生成可能扩大幻觉引用、无根据摘要或结构上可信但不完整的合成。 为此,我们明确将诊断图表衡量标准与基准制定评价分开,避免将内部综合分数作为人类学术判断的代名词。 我们还在代码探索和起草支助过程中使用AI助手,但所有报告的索赔都与存档的文物、日志核对,并在列入之前复制产出。

blocks.en: B.1 Offline Evaluation Rerun
blocks.zh: B.1 离线评价重新运行

blocks.en: We replayed the evaluator on an archived function-calling artifact using the repository’s fast configuration and with LLM-based judging disabled. The rerun produced an overall score of 78.14, with reference quality 77.50, structural soundness 70.50, content integrity 79.00, ethics/integrity 97.92, and rich media quality 68.17. This confirms that the evaluator is replayable on archived outputs, but it also shows that aggregate scores depend on whether LLM-assisted dimensions are active.
blocks.zh: 我们用存储器的快速配置和基于LLM的判断被禁用。 重播总体得分为78.14分,参考质量为77.50分,结构健全性为70.50分,内容完整性为79.00分,伦理/完整性为97.92分,媒体质量为68.17分. 这证实了评价者可以对存档产出进行回放,但也表明汇总分数取决于LLM辅助维度是否活性.

blocks.en: B.2 Fresh Uploaded-PDF End-to-End Smoke Runs
blocks.zh: B.2 新鲜上传的 PDF 尾到尾烟跑

blocks.en: A pair of fresh smoke runs was executed with the same single uploaded PDF under low-cost GLM and Qwen settings. In both runs, external search and most optional refinement stages were disabled to minimize cost while preserving end-to-end completion. The system successfully: • parsed one uploaded PDF, • completed the full generation pipeline, • rendered a final survey PDF together with L a T e X /Bib artifacts. These runs are intentionally minimal and therefore generate one-paper graphs with zero inter-paper relations, so they are not evidence of graph richness. Their role is narrower: to verify that fresh uploaded-PDF ingestion, outline generation, section synthesis, and final rendering all complete in the present repository under low-cost settings.
blocks.zh: 在低成本的GLM和Qwen设置下,用同一上传的单张PDF执行一对新鲜烟跑. 在这两个运行中,外部搜索和大多数可选的改进阶段被禁用,以尽量减少成本,同时保留端到端的完成. 该系统成功地:解析了上传的PDF,完成了全代管道,与L a T e X / Bib 文物一起完成了最后的PDF调查。 这些运行是故意最小的,因此产生一张纸的图表,零相纸间关系,因此它们不是图丰富的证据. 其作用更窄:验证新上传的-PDF摄入,大纲生成,分节合成,并在低成本的设置下最终将当前寄存器中的全部完成.

blocks.en: B.3 Same-Backend Generation-Stage Controlled Diagnostics
blocks.zh: B.3 同源后端控制诊断

blocks.en: To reduce model/backend confounding in generation-stage ablations, we ran a cost-capped Qwen diagnostic batch on Large Language Model Function Calling and retained its run manifest with the archived results. The batch uses max_parallel=1 , disables the external multi-judge evaluator, disables AI image generation, and keeps optional critical-analysis LLM paragraph enhancement off. The goal is bounded component evidence, not a SurveyBench leaderboard result or a same-backend rerun against MVSS/StructSurvey.
blocks.zh: 为了减少模型/后端在生成阶段的混乱,我们在大语言模型函数调用上运行了一个成本上限的Quen诊断批次,并保留了它与存档结果的运行清单。 批量使用max_并行=1,禁用外部多判断评价器,禁用AI图像生成,并保持可选的临界分析LLM段落增强. 该入球是受限成份证据,而不是Survey Bench领跑板的结果或同后端重跑来对抗MVSS/StructSurvey.

blocks.en: Table A.4: Artifact-backed same-backend generation-stage diagnostics. All rows are Qwen runs on the same topic with the same 30-paper/74-relation substrate where applicable. Rubric is the local rubric evaluator score; MEKG is the internal graph-native overall score. “–” means the summary did not record that field.
blocks.zh: 表A.4:人工活性支持同后端生成阶段诊断. 所有行为Quen运行在同一个话题上,在适用的情况下使用相同的30-paper/74-关系底板. Rubric是当地标分评价者得分;MEKG是内图-内图整体得分. " - " 指摘要没有记录这一领域。

blocks.en: The most useful signal is organizational rather than a simple score ordering. The full and no-critic/no-refine variants both remain in the good rubric band, indicating that the shared MEKG substrate and reflective content generator carry much of the artifact quality. Disabling the evolutionary analyzer leaves the internal MEKG score unchanged in this post-visual diagnostic but lowers global reflection from 3.80 to 3.50. The no-hybrid run completes and even improves the internal MEKG diagnostic because it cites a different subset of core papers, but its global reflection falls to 3.20 and the output shifts to a simpler five-section structure. We therefore use the diagnostic to support the default hybrid-outline design, while explicitly treating the no-hybrid result as a bounded fallback/control rather than a pristine collection-stage rerun. The non-monotonic ordering between the internal MEKG score and the rubric/global-reflection outcomes is itself informative: graph-native coverage and final-artifact quality measure different properties. Accordingly, the MEKG score is used only as an internal diagnostic, relation density is not treated as a final quality metric, and quality-facing evidence comes from grounding, hard-negative contrast, section alignment, and controlled generation behavior.
blocks.zh: 最有用的信号是组织,而不是简单的分数顺序. 完整的和无批评的/无反射的变体都留在好分幅带中,表明共享的MEKG底物和反射内容生成器承载了大部分的文物质量. 使进化分析器失效,使得这个后视诊断中内部的MEKG得分不变,但将全球反射从3.80降至3.50. 无韵母运行完成甚至改进了内部MEKG诊断,因为它引用了不同子集的核心文件,但其全球反射降至3.20,输出转向更简单的五节结构. 因此,我们利用诊断支持默认的混合出线设计,同时明确将无hybrid结果作为受限倒计时/控制而不是纯正的收集阶段再运行. 内部MEKG分数与分数/全球反射结果之间的非调取顺序本身是翔实的:图内覆盖和最终艺术质量测量不同属性. 因此,MEKG分数只用作内部诊断,关系密度不作为最终质量度量,质量成像证据出自地平面,硬负对比,区段对接,以及可控生成行为.

blocks.en: For the matched flat diagnostic in Table 4 , the flat run reuses the same 30-paper Function Calling corpus, Qwen configuration, top-down outline, and reflection settings, but its serialized graph contains zero relations and graph-derived paper attributes are stripped before generation. The final-body audit evaluates all recoverable cited sentences rather than a favorable subset. SurveyGraph improves the global-reflection score by 0.60 and grounding by 2.8 percentage points. Section alignment is 3/4 versus 3/5, with the same numerator and a one-section denominator difference, so it is retained only as a directional diagnostic. The hard-negative lexical contrast favors flat by 13.0 points. This mixed pattern is retained in the artifact and motivates the structural, rather than across-metric, interpretation in the main text.
blocks.zh: 对于表4中对应的平面诊断,平面运行重用相同的30相纸函数调用程序、Quen配置、自上而下大纲和反射设置,但其序列图中包含零关系和出自图表的纸张属性在生成前被剥去。 最后机构审计评价所有可收回的引用句子,而不是一个有利的子集。 SurveyGraph将全局反射分数提高了0.60分,地平分提高了2.8分. 区间对接为3/4对3/5,同分数和一分分分母差相同,因此仅保留为方向诊断. 硬阴相克法偏取平分13.0分. 这种混合模式被保留在文物中并激励了正文中的结构解释,而不是跨度解释.

blocks.en: B.4 Five-Topic Same-Backend Pipeline Completion
blocks.zh: B.4 5-Topic同源管道完成

blocks.en: To separate pipeline execution from the collection-stage SurveyBench probes, we additionally ran five complete surveys with Qwen-2.5 under the same 30-paper budget. Each run completed collection, MEKG construction, outlining, long-form generation, and PDF production. These artifacts support cross-topic pipeline completion only; they are not matched SurveyBench leaderboard runs and are not used to claim long-form quality superiority.
blocks.zh: 为了将管道执行从收集阶段的勘测班克探测器中分离出来,我们还在同样的30个文件预算下用Quen-2.5进行了五次完整的勘测. 每次运行完成的集合,MEKG构建,概括,长式生成,和PDF生产. 这些文物仅支持跨专题管线的完成;它们不匹配"勘测奔驰"(Survey Bench leader board runs),也不用于声称长式质量优越.

blocks.en: Table A.5: Five-topic same-backend pipeline-completion audit. All rows completed PDF production; the table reports structural scale rather than a quality score.
blocks.zh: 表A.5:五个专题的同后端管道-完成审计。 所有行都完成了PDF制作;表格报告的是结构尺度而不是质量分数.

blocks.en: B.5 Cross-Framework Artifact-Level Comparison
blocks.zh: B.5 跨框架工艺-水平比较

blocks.en: To strengthen the baseline side without over-claiming fair rerun parity, we additionally analyzed released artifacts bundled inside the local ARISE repository snapshot. This yielded 48 baseline artifacts that are directly inspectable without new generation cost: 3 AutoSurvey PDFs, 10 SurveyForge PDFs, 8 SurveyX PDFs, and 27 ARISE outputs. We then compared them with the two fresh SurveyGraph reruns at the artifact level, using lightweight structural and completeness signals such as page count, extracted text length, citation-marker count, section-heading count, figure/table mentions, and whether nearby L a T e X /Bib/review artifacts were available. We treat this comparison as an external-anchor artifact audit : it contextualizes the scale and completeness of SurveyGraph outputs against released artifacts from public systems, but it is not a same-topic, same-budget, same-backend live benchmark.
blocks.zh: 为了在不过分要求公平再运行平等的情况下加强基线方面,我们进一步分析了被捆绑在本地ARISE仓库快照中的释放出文物。 这产生了48件可以直接检查而无需新一代成本的基线文物:3件自动调查PDF;10件勘测福克PDF;8件勘测福克PDF;27件ARISE产出。 然后,我们用轻量级的结构和完整性信号,如页数、所提取的文字长度、引用标记数、分页数、数字/表格提及,以及附近的L a T e X / Bib/审查文物是否可用,将它们与文物一级的两个新调查Graph重播进行比较。 我们把这种比较视为一种外部锁定的文物审计:它根据公共系统释放的文物来分析SurveyGraph产出的规模和完整性,但它不是一个相同的专题、相同的预算、相同的后端直播基准。

blocks.en: Table A.6: System-level summary of the released artifact comparison. This table should be read as an artifact-backed structural/completeness audit, not as a fair live rerun benchmark.
blocks.zh: 表A.6:公布文物比较的系统级汇总. 本表应被解读为人工支撑的结构/完成性审计,而不应被解读为公平直播再运行的基准.

blocks.en: The main value of this comparison is twofold. First, it shows that SurveyGraph fresh reruns produce complete inspectable writing artifacts rather than only intermediate logs. Second, it provides a low-cost external anchor for artifact scale and completeness against public systems whose released outputs are already bundled in the workspace. It does not justify quality-ranking claims across systems because the evidence mixes fresh reruns and released outputs from heterogeneous topics.
blocks.zh: 这一比较的主要价值是双重的。 首先,它表明"勘测Graph"新鲜再运行生产出完整的可检查的写作文物,而不仅仅是中间日志. 第二,它提供了一个低成本的外部锚点,用于对已经将所释放的产出捆绑在工作空间的公共系统进行人工规模和完整性分析。 它不能作为跨系统质量等级索赔的理由,因为证据混合了新的重播,并释放出不同专题的产出。

blocks.en: B.5.1 Released-Artifact Dedup Robustness Check
blocks.zh: B.5.1 释放的 -- -- 艺术品 Dedup 强健检查

blocks.en: Because released artifact folders may contain copied PDFs, we ran one extra SHA-based dedup check over the 50 total artifact-comparison rows (48 released artifacts plus the two fresh SurveyGraph reruns). This found 4 exact-PDF duplicate groups (4 removable rows total), affecting ARISE, SurveyForge, and SurveyX. After deduplication, system-level means moved only modestly—for example, ARISE citation mentions shifted from 453.30 to 436.84, SurveyForge from 406.50 to 424.89, and SurveyX from 273.12 to 264.57—without reversing the qualitative comparison story. We therefore keep the original artifact table for transparency while treating the cross-framework comparison as structurally informative rather than numerically precise.
blocks.zh: 因为出厂的文物文件夹可能包含被复制的PDF,我们额外对50个文物对比行(48个出厂的文物外加两个新鲜的SurveyGraph再运行)进行了一次基于SHA的解析检查. 这发现4个精确的PDF重复组(共4行可移动行),影响了ARISE,SurveyForge和SurveyX. 系统层面的手段在出现分解后只略有变化,例如,ARISE的引文提到从453.30转至436.84;SurveyForge从406.50转至424.89;SurveyX从273.12转至264.57,但没有改变定性比较的情况。 因此,我们保持原始的工艺表的透明度,同时将跨框架比较视为结构信息而不是数字精确。

blocks.en: Table A.7: Released-artifact dedup robustness check. Exact-PDF duplicates were removed by SHA-256 prefix; the resulting shifts are modest and do not change the paper’s qualitative artifact-level comparison claims.
blocks.zh: 表A.7:释放的甲状腺脱落强度检查。 SHA-256前缀删除了精确的PDF复制件;由此产生的转变幅度不大,并不改变纸质文物水平比较索赔。

blocks.en: B.5.2 Structural-Proxy Robustness Check
blocks.zh: B.5.2 结构健全检查

blocks.en: Because the artifact-level comparison relies on cheap PDF-structure proxies, we ran one more zero-cost audit over the same 50 rows. The goal is not to claim that heading extraction is perfect, but to test whether the comparison is dominated by a brittle parser. Across all 50 rows, 47 exposed non-zero table-of-contents (TOC) entries. Among those 47 rows, the extracted TOC count matched the extracted section-heading count exactly in all cases (100.0%). The only heading-count mismatch in the full table came from one AutoSurvey PDF that had no recoverable TOC but one detected heading. References headings were recoverable in 94.0% of all rows and in every artifact from ARISE, SurveyForge, SurveyX, and the two fresh SurveyGraph reruns. This supports a narrow interpretation: the artifact-level structural comparison still depends on proxy metrics, but those proxies are internally consistent for nearly all released/fresh PDFs that expose a usable document structure.
blocks.zh: 因为文物水平的比较依赖于廉价的PDF结构代名词,我们又对同样的50行进行了一次零成本的审计. 目的不是声称标题取出是完美的,而是检验比较是否由出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出 在所有50行中,47行披露了非零内容表条目。 在这47行中,抽取的TOC计数与抽取的区长计数完全一致(100.0%)。 完整表格中唯一的标题计算不匹配来自一个AutoSurvey PDF,它没有可收回的TOC,只有一个检测到的标题. 参考标题可在94.0%的所有行和每个文物中收回,分别来自ARISE、SurveyForge、SurveyX和两个新鲜的SurveyGraph。 这支持狭义的解释:文物级的结构比较仍然依赖于代用度量,但这些代用度量对于几乎所有的被放出/被取出暴露出可使用的文件结构的PDF来说,内部一致.

blocks.en: Table A.8: Structural-proxy robustness audit over the 50 artifact-level comparison rows. Cheap structure proxies are internally consistent for nearly all artifacts that expose a usable TOC signal.
blocks.zh: 表A.8:对50个文物级比较行进行结构-代理稳健性审核. 对于几乎所有暴露出可用TOC信号的文物来说,廉价结构代词在内部是一致的.

blocks.en: B.5.3 Length-Normalized Artifact Proxy Check
blocks.zh: B.5.3 长度 -- -- 正常人工活性代理检查

blocks.en: To test whether the artifact-level comparison is driven only by raw PDF length, we ran one more zero-cost audit over the same comparison table after SHA-based deduplication. This leaves 46 unique rows. For each system, we normalize citation-marker counts by words (per 1k words), section headings by words (per 10k words), and figure+table mentions by words (per 10k words), while also tracking whether editable L a T e X /Bib artifacts are available. The result is intentionally narrow: it does not rank quality, but it does check whether the previously reported structural differences survive a simple document-length normalization.
blocks.zh: 为了检验文物层面的比较是否仅由原始的PDF长度驱动,我们在基于SHA的分解后对同一个比较表又进行了一次零成本审计. 这留下了46行独特的行. 对于每个系统,我们正常的引用-标记按单词计数(每1k个字),节标题按单词计数(每10k个字),图+表按单词计数(每10k个字),同时也跟踪是否可以编辑L a T e X / Bib 文物. 结果是有意缩小的:它不排序质量,但它确实检查以前报告的结构性差异是否在简单的文件长度正常化后存活.

blocks.en: The normalized pattern still differs across systems. ARISE remains structurally dense after normalization, with a median heading density of 22.10 per 10k words and a figure/table density of 9.69 per 10k words, while also preserving a 100% editable-artifact rate. SurveyGraph’s two fresh reruns remain much shorter in citation density (2.56 per 1k words combined), but they still retain non-zero heading density (14.81 per 10k words), non-zero figure/table density (13.12 per 10k words), and a 100% editable-artifact rate. AutoSurvey remains near zero on normalized heading and figure/table density, whereas SurveyX stays high on both normalized citation and heading density. This suggests that the cross-framework artifact comparison is not only a page-length effect.
blocks.zh: 不同系统之间的正常化模式仍然不同。 ARISE在正常化后结构上仍然密集,中间方向密度为每10克字22.10个,数字/表密度为每10克字9.69个,同时保持了100%的可编辑艺术率. SurveyGraph的两次新重播在引用密度(每1克单词加2.56个)上仍然短得多,但它们仍然保留了非零向密度(每10克单词为14.81个),非零相/表密度(每10克单词为13.12个)和100%可编辑艺术率. 自动调查在正常标题和数字/表密度上仍然接近零,而调查X在正常引用和向密度上都保持高水平。 这表明跨框架的文物比较不仅仅是一页长的效果.
