blocks.zh: 表A.9:对46个已脱落的比较行进行长度正常的文物代理审计. 发布/更新的结构比较不只以原始文件长度来解释。

blocks.en: B.6 SciSage Outline-Only Live Partial Baseline
blocks.zh: B.6 剪切图 -- -- 仅限活的部分基线

blocks.en: We executed four live SciSage partial baselines by reusing its native outline-generation path only, patching the model backend to a DashScope-compatible endpoint, and skipping full section writing, RAG retrieval, and full-paper synthesis. The final matched set contains four same-topic low-cost runs on Document Visual Question Answering , Text-to-SQL Agent , Large Language Model Function Calling , and Memory in the Age of AI Agents with the DashScope-backed qwen3.6-plus chat model. These experiments remain outline-stage partial baselines, but they are materially stronger than the earlier topic-adjacent check because both topic and backend family are matched to archived SurveyGraph slices on four topics.
blocks.zh: 我们执行了四个活的SciSage部分基线,只使用其原生的轮廓生成路径,将模型后端补上DashScope相容的端点,并跳过全段写作,RAG检索,和全纸合成. 最终匹配集包含4个同题低价运行的文档可视化问答,Text to-SQL代理,大语言模型函数调用,以及带有DashScope后置的Qwen3.6-plus聊天模式的AI代理时代记忆. 这些实验仍然是大纲阶段的部分基线,但实质上比早先的专题相邻检查更强,因为专题和后端家族都与存档的关于四个专题的SurveyGraph切片相匹配.

blocks.en: Table A.10: One real same-backend matched subset on Document Visual Question Answering . This is not full-paper parity: SurveyGraph is an archived full run, while SciSage is a live outline-only run.
blocks.zh: 表A.10: 经常预算 一个真实的同后端匹配的文档可视问题回答子集 。 这不是全纸面的平等: SurveyGraph是存档的全跑道,而SciSage则是仅限大纲的活跑道.

blocks.en: We also ran one extra zero-cost structure-only comparison over the same matched DocVQA pair. Instead of scoring content quality, this check aligns the top-level section titles to a coarse set of survey roles (introduction/scope, task background, motivation, methods, evaluation, challenges, conclusion). Under this title-role view, the archived SurveyGraph outline covers 7 unique roles, while the live SciSage outline covers 4. The longest shared ordered role subsequence has length 4 ( intro/scope → \rightarrow task/background → \rightarrow methods → \rightarrow challenges ), which yields a 0.571 SciSage role-recall against the SurveyGraph outline template for this topic. The missing roles are motivation , evaluation , and conclusion . We treat this as a coarse structural-coverage probe only: it does not score subsection quality, retrieval evidence, or full-paper usefulness.
blocks.zh: 我们还做了一个额外的零成本结构的比较 与同一对匹配的DocVQA对。 本检查不是评分内容质量,而是将顶级的章节标题与一套粗糙的调查角色(引入/范围,任务背景,动机,方法,评价,挑战,结论)相协调. 在这个标题-作用的视角下,存档的"调查Graph"大纲涵盖7个独特的角色,而活生生的"剪刀"大纲涵盖 4. 最长的共享定型角色分序有第4行(内向/镜-\正弦任务/后向-正弦方法-\正弦挑战),该分序产生0.571个剪切角色回顾,与《概览》这个专题的大纲模板相对应。 缺少的角色是动机、评价和结论。 我们只把这当作一个粗糙的结构覆盖探测器: 它没有分层质量,检索证据,或者全纸的有用性。

blocks.en: Table A.11: Four same-backend-family matched subsets aggregated across Document Visual Question Answering , Text-to-SQL Agent , Large Language Model Function Calling , and Memory in the Age of AI Agents . Three of the four live SciSage runs pass their reflection gate; the memory-topic run fails and is also the structurally narrowest.
blocks.zh: 表A.11: 经常预算 四个相同后端- 家族的子集, 4个活生生的Scisage跑道中有3个通过倒影门;内存-专题跑道失败,也是结构上最窄的跑道.

blocks.en: The second matched topic, Text-to-SQL Agent , follows the same qualitative pattern while adding topic diversity at very low cost. The archived SurveyGraph slice exposes a 5-paper external-core proxy target set with 0.400 top-20 proxy recall together with a 7-section/40-node outline, whereas the live SciSage outline-only run returns a 3-section/9-node outline in 132.27 seconds and passes the same reflection gate. We then add matched runs on Large Language Model Function Calling and Memory in the Age of AI Agents . The memory-topic baseline is useful precisely because it is a negative case: the archived SurveyGraph slice still exposes a 7-section/38-node outline, while the live SciSage run collapses to only 2 top-level sections and 4 total nodes in 140.17 seconds and fails SciSage’s own reflection gate. Aggregated over the four matched topics, the live SciSage runs have mean latency 131.97 seconds, mean role-recall 0.429, and a 0.75 reflection-gate pass rate, but still leave motivation- and conclusion-like roles systematically under-covered relative to the archived SurveyGraph outlines. We again stress that this is a structure-stage matched-subset comparison only, not a full-paper quality benchmark.
blocks.zh: 第二个匹配的话题"Text-to-SQL Agent"遵循相同的定性模式,同时以非常低的成本添加了主题多样性. 存档的"SurveyGraph"片段曝出一出5相纸外核代用指标,设定了0.400上20相纸外核代用召回以及7相平分/40相平分-节点提纲;而活生生的"SciSage"大纲-只跑则在132.27秒内返回了3相平分/9相平分-节点提纲并经过同一反射门. 在AI代理时代, 记忆-主题基线之所以有用,正是因为这是一个负面案例:存档的SurveyGraph切片仍然暴露出一个7节/38节节点的大纲,而活生生的SciSage运行到140.17秒内只有2个顶级分会和4个总节会倒塌,并未能达到SciSage自己的反射门. 在四个相匹配的题目上,现场SciSage的跑道具有平均潜伏度131.97秒,平均角色召回0.429,和0.75反射门通过率,但相对于存档的"SurveyGraph"大纲,仍然系统性地让动机和结论式角色被覆盖不足. 我们再次强调,这只是一个结构阶段匹配的子集比较,而不是一个完整的纸张质量基准。

blocks.en: To add one more benchmark-facing check at near-zero cost, we first replayed the archived section-to-paper retrieval diagnostic on two matched topics and then expanded that replay to a four-topic replay that better matches the paper’s structural claim. The stronger replay compares three retrieval settings on the same archived topic slices and survey-reference external proxy targets: flat lexical retrieval, a simpler structural/meta graph that removes evolutionary semantic edges, and the full typed MEKG. On Document Visual Question Answering , recall rises from 0.125 (flat) to 0.125 (simple graph) to 0.167 (full graph), with precision rising from 0.130 to 0.136 to 0.190. On Large Language Model Function Calling , both graph variants recover one proxy hit where flat retrieval recovers none (0.000 → \rightarrow 0.077). On Memory in the Age of AI Agents and Text-to-SQL Agent , recall remains tied, but both graph variants still increase relation density relative to flat retrieval. Averaged across the four matched topics, flat retrieval reaches 0.135 mean top- 5 5 external-proxy recall and 0.087 precision, the simpler graph reaches 0.154 recall and 0.090 precision, and the full typed graph reaches 0.164 recall and 0.105 precision. Relation density rises from 0.120 to 0.163 and 0.165 respectively. Because the sample is only four topics, the paired tests are still inconclusive, but the replay addresses the simpler-baseline question with controlled evidence.
blocks.zh: 为了以接近零的成本再增加一个基准制的检查,我们首先在两个匹配的题目上重放存档的区间对纸检索诊断,然后将重放扩大到一个四个专题的重放,更好地与纸的结构性索赔相匹配。 更强的回放比较了相同存档主题切片上的三个回取设置和调查参考外置代理目标:平面词典回取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取 关于文件视觉问题回答,召回率从0.125(平面)上升至0.125(平面图)上升至0.167(平面图),精度从0.130升至0.136升至0.190. 在大语言模型函数调用中,两个图形变体都恢复了一个代理命中,其中平面检索没有恢复(0.000 ~\正弦 0.077). 在AI代理和Text-to-SQL代理时代的记忆上,召回仍然被绑定,但两个图变体相对于平面检索仍然会提高关系密度. 平均在四个相匹配的专题中,平面回取达到0.135正值上-5 5外-代用回取和0.087精度,更简单的回取图达到0.154回取和0.090精度,打出的全部回取图达到0.164回取和0.105精度. 关系密度分别从0.120到0.163和0.165. 由于样本只有4个话题,配对测试仍无定论,但回放用可控证据解决了更简单的基准问题.

blocks.en: Table A.12: Four-topic matched replay of the archived retrieval diagnostic against survey-reference external proxy targets. The simpler structural/meta graph already improves relation density over flat retrieval, while the full typed graph adds a small further gain in both mean recall and mean precision.
blocks.zh: 表A.12:对照调查参考外部代理目标对存档检索诊断进行四专题匹配的回放。 更简单的结构/元图已经比平面检索改善了关系密度,而完整的打入的图则在平均回想和平均精度方面都增加了一点进一步收益.

blocks.en: We also added a seven-run GraphRAG-lite matched baseline to avoid comparing typed MEKG retrieval only against flat lexical retrieval. This baseline builds a local TF-IDF k-nearest-neighbor graph from each run’s paper titles, abstracts, and category strings, applies the same one-hop graph ranker and top- 5 5 per-section budget, and evaluates against the same weak survey-reference external proxy. The result is intentionally mixed and therefore useful: the TF-IDF kNN graph obtains higher weak-proxy recall than both flat lexical retrieval and typed full-MEKG retrieval (0.347 vs. 0.252 and 0.153), while typed MEKG variants expose much denser neighborhoods under the archived MEKG relation yardstick. This confirms that simple similarity graphs are strong retrieval baselines on the current proxy and that the typed MEKG should be claimed as an auditable structural representation rather than as a universally better recall mechanism. The full output is saved under the GraphRAG-lite directory in the artifact map above.
blocks.zh: 我们还增加了7个运行的GraphRAG-lite匹配基线,以避免只将打入的MEKG检索与平面的Lexical检索进行比较。 这个基线从每个运行的纸张标题、摘要和类别字符串中构建一个本地的TF-IDF k-近邻图,应用相同的一跃图分级符和每节预算前5名,并对照相同的薄弱的调查参考外部代理来评价。 结果故意混合,因此有用:TF-IDF kNN图比平面的词典检索和打入的完整-MEKG检索(0.347对0.252和0.153)获得更高的弱副电荷回放,而打入的MEKG变体则在存档的MEKG关系标尺下暴露出更密集的邻里. 这证实,简单的相似性图表是当前代用物上强有力的检索基线,而打入的MEKG应作为可审计的结构代表,而不是作为普遍更好的召回机制。 完整的输出被保存在以上文物地图中的GraphRAG-lite目录下.

blocks.en: Table A.13: Seven-run GraphRAG-lite matched baseline replay. MEKG dens. measures typed-MEKG connectivity among retrieved papers; Act. dens. measures density in the graph used by the method. The TF-IDF kNN graph is a strong lightweight recall baseline on this weak proxy, while typed MEKG variants provide denser typed-neighborhood evidence.
blocks.zh: 表A.13:7运行的GraphRAG-lite匹配基线重播. MEKG 密度。 (c) 使用该方法的图表中测量密度。 TF-IDF kNN图是这个弱代名词上一个强大的轻量级回想基线,而打入的MEKG变体则提供了更密集的打入相邻的证据.

blocks.en: To check whether the GraphRAG-lite baseline is a single-parameter accident, we additionally swept 16 TF-IDF kNN settings by varying the neighbor count k ∈ { 2 , 3 , 5 , 8 } k\in\{2,3,5,8\} and minimum similarity threshold { 0.00 , 0.05 , 0.10 , 0.15 } \{0.00,0.05,0.10,0.15\} . Every tested setting remains above the flat lexical recall baseline (0.252), with recall ranging from 0.274 to 0.347. The best and balanced setting is the one used above ( k = 5 k=5 , threshold 0.05), with R@5 0.347 and P@5 0.176. This reinforces the conservative interpretation: simple similarity-graph retrieval is a strong baseline, so our typed-MEKG claim should emphasize structure, typed evidence, and auditability rather than raw weak-proxy recall dominance.
blocks.zh: 为了检查GraphRAG-lite基线是否是单参数事故,我们通过改变邻居的计数k {2,3,5,8}k\in 2,3,5,8}和最小相似性阈值{0.00,0.05,0.10,0.15} 0.00,0.05,0.10,0.15},进一步扫过了16个TF-IDF kNN设置. 每个经过测试的设置仍高于平面法召回基线(0.252),召回范围从0.274到0.347. 最佳和平衡的设置是上面使用的设置(k=5克=5,阈值0.05),其中R@5 0.347和P@5 0.176. 这强化了保守的解释:简单的相似性-图回取是一个很强的基线,所以我们所打入的-MEKG索赔应该强调结构,打出的证据,以及可审计性,而不是原始的弱副回取的主导.

blocks.en: Table A.14: GraphRAG-lite sensitivity sweep over 16 TF-IDF kNN settings. The table shows the threshold-0.05 slice plus the overall sweep range; all tested settings exceed the flat lexical recall baseline on the same weak external proxy.
blocks.zh: 表A.14:GraphRAG-lite灵敏度扫射了16个TF-IDF kNN设置. 该表显示出阈值-0.05切片外加整体扫荡范围;所有被测试的设置都超过了同一弱外代用上平面的词典召回基线.

blocks.en: We also add an OpenAlex-backed bibliometric rerank baseline that uses title-matched cited_by_count , recency, and a lightweight paper-role prior, without using MEKG edges. Under the same seven-run weak survey-reference proxy and top- 5 5 per-section budget, the strongest graph-free quality variant is lexical–bibliometric reciprocal-rank fusion (R@5/P@5 0.309/0.194), improving over flat lexical retrieval (0.252/0.132). This result is important because it shows that part of the retrieval gain can be obtained without typed relations; SurveyGraph’s safer claim is therefore not raw recall superiority, but auditability and controllable fusion.
blocks.zh: 我们还增加了一个 OpenAlex 后置的双缩写重排基准,该基准使用标题相匹配的引用_by_counter, recertency, 以及轻量级的纸张作用前置,而不使用 MEKG 边缘 。 在同一由7个运行的弱调查参考代理和每款预算前5名下,最强的无图质量变体是Lexical-bibiliometery对等级聚变(R@5/P@5 0.309/0.194),比平分法检索(0.252/0.132)有所改善. 这一结果很重要,因为它表明部分检索收益可以在没有打字关系的情况下获得;因此,SurveyGraph更安全的主张不是原始的召回优势,而是可审计性和可控制的聚变.

blocks.en: Table A.15: OpenAlex-backed quality-aware retrieval baseline over the same seven-run weak survey-reference proxy. Quality is the normalized citation/recency/role score among retrieved papers; Cites is mean OpenAlex cited_by_count . This is a matched retrieval-stage baseline, not a full reproduction of quality-aware survey generation systems.
blocks.zh: 表A.15: OpenAlex支持质量意识检索基线,覆盖同一7个运行的弱调查参考代理. 质量是检索到的论文中正常的引用/recency/作用分数; Cites是OpenAlex 引用的"by_counts"的取名. 这是一个匹配的检索阶段基线,而不是对质量意识调查生成系统的充分复制。

blocks.en: We then combined the strongest graph-free quality baseline with TF-IDF GraphRAG-lite and typed-MEKG retrieval in one equal-budget mini-benchmark. Table A.16 uses the same section queries, same top- 5 5 budget, and same weak proxy for all methods. The best weak-proxy method is bibliometric-anchor + TF-IDF fusion (R@5/P@5 0.357/0.200). Full typed MEKG alone has lower weak-proxy recall but much higher typed-neighborhood density, while safe fusion recovers part of the recall without abandoning typed structure. This directly motivates our final positioning: simple quality/similarity baselines are strong, and typed MEKG is most useful when used as an auditable structure and fusion signal.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们把最强的无图质量基线与TF-IDF GraphRAG-lite和打入-MEKG检索合并在一个平分预算的小型基准中。 表A.16使用相同的款次查询,相同的最高 -- -- 5个预算,以及同样的弱取用所有方法。 最好的弱代氧法是双聚-芳香克+TF-IDF聚变法(R@5/P@50.357/0.200). 完全被打入的MEKG单独具有更低的弱-副氧回想,但打入的邻接密度要高得多,而安全的聚变则在不放弃打入的结构的情况下恢复了部分回想. 这直接激发了我们的最终定位:简单的质量/相似性基线很强,而打入的MEKG在用作可审计结构和聚变信号时最有用.

blocks.en: Table A.16: Seven-run matched quality/graph mini-benchmark. All methods use the same archived section queries and top- 5 5 retrieval budget. Align is a lexical section-evidence alignment proxy, and Dens. is typed-MEKG relation density among retrieved papers.
blocks.zh: 表A.16:7运行的匹配质量/图示微型基准. 所有方法都使用相同的已存档的段落查询和上 -- 5 5检索预算。 Align是一个词典化的段落-证据对齐代理,而 Dens.在被检索的论文中被打入-MEKG关系密度.

blocks.en: B.7 Baseline Audit Summary
blocks.zh: B.7 基线审计摘要

blocks.en: Table A.17: Updated baseline audit summary after adding released artifact analysis and four same-topic live partial baselines. None of these systems should yet be counted as fully and fairly reproduced under a unified environment.
blocks.zh: 表A.17: 经常预算 在添加了已公布的文物分析和四个相同主题的现场部分基线后,更新了基线审计摘要。 这些系统中还没有一个在统一的环境中被算作充分和公平地重新使用。

blocks.en: Together, these checks justify a narrow claim set: SurveyGraph has real archived outputs, fresh low-cost end-to-end completions, same-backend internal generation diagnostics, and a partially replayable comparison story that now includes released cross-framework artifacts plus four same-topic live partial baselines. Full same-topic, same-budget, same-backend cross-system baseline parity remains future work.
blocks.zh: 这些检查加在一起证明一个狭义的主张集是合理的:SurveyGraph有真实的存档产出,新鲜的低成本端到端完成,同后端的内部生成诊断,以及部分可回放的比较故事,其中现在包括释放的跨框架文物外加四个同题活性部分基线. 同专题、同预算、同后端的跨系统基线均等仍然是今后的工作。

blocks.en: B.8 SurveyBench Reference-List Probe
blocks.zh: B.8 调查本克-参考清单

blocks.en: We also run a zero-API probe against the local SurveyBench snapshot bundled with the SurveyForge repository. We reused the public benchmark script’s citation-coverage definition: after date filtering, the score is the fraction of generated reference IDs that appear in the topic’s benchmark reference set. This is still not an end-to-end SurveyGraph benchmark run, because our archived SurveyGraph topics are not the ten SurveyBench topics and the SurveyForge local code path requires missing database/embedding assets for a live matched rerun. It does, however, calibrate what the benchmark-format reference metric looks like on the released SurveyForge and human reference lists, and it quantifies how little of the present SurveyGraph archive can be reused as a proxy.
blocks.zh: 我们还对本地的"勘测本克"快照进行零API探测,与"勘测福克"寄存器捆绑. 我们重用公共基准脚本的引用-覆盖定义:经过日期过滤后,分数是生成的参考ID在主题基准参考集中出现的分数. 这仍然不是一个端到端的SurveyGraph基准运行,因为我们存档的SurveyGraph主题不是"十个"Survey Bench"主题,而SurveyForge本地代码路径需要缺失数据库/嵌入资产进行活匹配重跑. 然而,它确实对公布的SurveyForge和人类参考清单中基准格式参考度表的外观进行了校正,并量化了目前SurveyGraph档案中很少能作为代用。

The SurveyGraph rows are only top-overlap checks between existing archived corpora and SurveyBench topics, not end-to-end benchmark runs.
blocks.zh: 表A.18:使用当地勘测福尔吉勘测本克快照的勘测本克参考列表探测器. SurveyForge和人行是真正的基准格式参考清单评价。 调查格拉夫行只是对现有存档的Corpora和Survey Bench主题之间的顶端重叠检查,而不是端到端的基准运行.

blocks.en: The released SurveyForge references obtain nontrivial but topic-variable coverage: 0.857 on 3D Gaussian Splatting , 0.598 on Generative Diffusion Models , 0.435 on Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models , and 0.296 on LLM-based Multi-Agent . By contrast, the strongest SurveyGraph archive-to-benchmark overlaps are 11 references for LLM-based Multi-Agent from the function-calling archive and 10 references for Evaluation of Large Language Models ; these are far too small to support a benchmark claim. We include the result as a reproducible calibration and as a guardrail: future benchmark evaluation must run SurveyGraph on the SurveyBench topics with matched retrieval budgets and reference extraction, rather than treating unrelated archives as benchmark evidence.
blocks.zh: 发行的SurveyForge参考文献获得非三角但主题可变的覆盖:3D高斯平板机上0.857;Generative Divusion Models上0.598;大语言模型检索-增强生成0.435;基于LM的多代理0.296。 相比之下,最强的SurveyGraph归档到基准的重叠是功能调用档案中基于LLM的多代理的11个参考文献和大语言模型评价的10个参考文献;这些参考文献太小,无法支持基准索赔. 我们把这一结果作为可复制的校正和护卫工具列入:今后的基准评价必须用匹配的检索预算和参考材料提取来管理 " 调查本 " 专题的 " 调查图表 " ,而不是将无关的档案作为基准证据。

blocks.en: To add one small amount of genuinely live benchmark-facing evidence without paying for new long-form generation, we also ran an exact-topic arXiv retrieval probe through the repository’s own retriever over all 10 SurveyBench topics, capping each topic at 50 returned papers and then scoring the retrieved arXiv IDs with the same date-filtered overlap rule. This collection-stage probe is deliberately narrower than an end-to-end survey benchmark: it does not test outlining, writing, or claim support. It nevertheless shows that the repository retriever can recover nontrivial benchmark references from live search alone, reaching 0.245 mean overlap coverage and 5.1 matched references per topic. The strongest topics are Hallucination in Large Language Models (0.500; 6/12 valid targets matched), 3D Gaussian Splatting (0.412; 7/17), and Multimodal Large Language Models (0.357; 5/14), while Graph Neural Networks remains low (0.051; 2/39) and LLM-based Multi-Agent still yields 0/3 matched targets under the benchmark’s date filter. We therefore use this probe only to demonstrate live benchmark-facing retrieval viability, not end-to-end benchmark parity.
blocks.zh: 为了增加少量真正的活性基准证据而无需支付新的长形一代的费用,我们还通过存储库本身的检索器,对所有10个调查本克专题进行了精确的专题arXiv检索调查,将每个专题封顶在50份退回的论文上,然后对检索的arXivID进行同日期过滤重叠规则的评分。 这种收集阶段探测器有意比端到端调查基准更窄:它不测试概述、写作或索赔支持。 然而,它表明,存储器检索器可以从仅现场搜索中收回非三角基准参考文献,达到0.245平均重叠覆盖面,每个专题5.1对应参考文献。 最强的话题是"大语言模型中的幻觉"(0.500;6/12有效目标匹配),"3D高斯电镀"(0.412;7/17)和"多模式大语言模型"(0.357;5/14),而"图形神经网络"(Graph Neural Networks)仍然很低(0.051;2/39),基于LLM的多代理仍然在基准日期过滤器下得出0/3匹配目标. 因此,我们使用这个探测器只是为了展示活性基准的检索可行性,而不是端到端的基准等同.

blocks.en: To further strengthen benchmark-facing evidence without paying for full survey generation, we ran a second live collection-stage probe using the repository’s EnhancedPaperCollector rather than exact-topic search alone. This probe covers four SurveyBench topics ( LLM-based Multi-Agent , Evaluation of Large Language Models , Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models , and Multimodal Large Language Models ) under a fixed 8-paper collection budget. Mean benchmark-reference coverage reaches 0.521, compared with 0.166 for the exact-topic probe on the same four topics, and all four topics improve. The largest gain is on Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models (0.188 → \rightarrow 1.000), while LLM-based Multi-Agent rises from 0.000 to 0.333. Because this probe still measures only collection-stage overlap, we treat it as stronger retrieval evidence rather than as end-to-end benchmark success.
blocks.zh: 为了在不支付全部调查费用的情况下进一步加强制定基准的证据,我们利用存储器的EndroductionPaperCollector,而不仅仅是精确的专题搜索,进行了第二次现场收集阶段的探测。 本调查涵盖四个调查本克专题(基于LLM的多代理、大语言模型的评价、大语言模型检索-增强生成和多模式大语言模型),根据固定的8个论文收集预算。 平均基准参考覆盖率为0.521,而关于同一四个专题的精确专题调查为0.166,所有四个专题都有所改善。 最大的收益是大语言模型的检索-增强生成(0.188 →\rightarrow 1.000),而基于LLM的多代理则从0.000升至0.333. 因为这个探测器仍然只测量收集阶段的重叠,所以我们把它视为更强的检索证据,而不是端到端的基准成功.

blocks.en: Appendix C Additional Low-Cost Diagnostics
blocks.zh: 附录C 低成本诊断

blocks.en: To strengthen the evidence without additional long-form generation, we ran fourteen extra post-hoc analyses over the already saved artifacts: the original ten local diagnostics, plus an encoder-sensitivity replay, a graph-safe fusion sweep, a semantic-gate error analysis, and a local cost-stage replay. All fourteen analyses are fully local and reproducible from the current workspace, except for already completed live collection probes explicitly marked as live in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 为了在不增加长形生成的情况下强化证据,我们额外对已经保存的文物进行了14个后热分析:最初的10个局部诊断,加上编码器敏感性回放,图安全聚变扫描,语义门出错分析,以及局部成本舞台回放. 所有14个分析都是完全本地的,从目前的工作空间可以复制,但已完成的现场收集探测器除外,这些探测器在附录B中明确标记为活性。

blocks.en: C.1 Offline Retrieval-Side Graph Diagnostic
blocks.zh: C.1 离线检索-侧图诊断

blocks.en: We constructed a fixed-budget diagnostic ablation over the eight archived runs. For each non-introduction/non-conclusion top-level section, we retrieved the top- 5 5 papers with (i) a flat lexical section-to-paper ranker and (ii) a graph-aware ranker that adds category/subcategory overlap, PageRank centrality, and 1-hop relation expansion from the strongest lexical seeds. We then compared the union of retrieved papers under graph-native targets: core-paper recall, community coverage, average PageRank exposure, and relation density among retrieved papers. This experiment is intentionally diagnostic and should not be read as a public benchmark.

blocks.en: An exact paired sign-flip check over the same eight archived run pairs shows that the retrieval-side gain is not carried by only one or two outliers. Core-paper recall, average PageRank exposure, and relation density are all positive in 8/8 non-zero pairs, each with one-sided p = 0.0039 p=0.0039 and two-sided p = 0.0078 p=0.0078 . Community coverage is directionally positive but weaker: 5 positive pairs, 1 negative pair, and 2 ties, giving one-sided p = 0.0781 p=0.0781 and two-sided p = 0.1563 p=0.1563 . We report these values as compact diagnostic evidence only, not as benchmark-grade significance claims.

blocks.en: We also ran one small signal-component ablation on the same archived retrieval setup to separate the contributions of category/subcategory overlap, PageRank centrality, and 1-hop relation expansion. The most important result is that 1-hop expansion carries most of the observed retrieval-side lift: removing expansion drops mean core recall from 0.373 to 0.219 and relation density from 0.259 to 0.161, nearly matching the flat lexical baseline (0.216/0.162). By contrast, removing centrality only weakens mean core recall to 0.364 and relation density to 0.254, while removing category/subcategory overlap is nearly neutral on the current archived runs. We therefore treat the present graph-aware retrieval gain as primarily an expansion effect, with centrality as a secondary preference signal and overlap as a weak tie-breaker under this archive slice.
blocks.zh: 我们还在同一存档检索设置上运行了一个小信号组件,以区分类别/子类别重叠、PageRank中心化和1-hop关系扩展等贡献。 最重要的结果是1-hop扩展搭载了所观测到的大部分取回-侧升降:去除膨胀回落指核心回落从0.373回落到0.219回落,而关系密度从0.259回落到0.161回落,几乎与平面法基线相匹配(0.216/0.162). 相形之下,去除中心只会将平均核心召回弱化为0.364,关系密度为0.254,而去除类别/子类别重叠则在目前的存档运行中几乎是中性的. 因此,我们把目前的图感检索收益主要视为一种扩展效应,其中心地位作为次要偏好信号,而重叠则作为这个档案片下一个弱的断接器。

blocks.en: C.2.1 Confidence-Threshold Robustness Sweep
blocks.zh: C.2.1 信心保障

blocks.en: To test whether the graph-aware gain depends mainly on low-confidence edges, we replayed the same top- 5 5 retrieval diagnostic after pruning the archived MEKG to only relations with confidence at least 0.5, 0.7, or 0.9. The gain weakens mildly under stricter pruning, but it remains positive on both core-paper recall and relation density even at the highest threshold. This makes the current retrieval result more robust than a purely weak-edge explanation would suggest.
blocks.zh: 为了测试图感知增益是否主要取决于低信心边缘,我们重新播放了相同的上-5 5回取诊断,然后将存档的MEKG推向只有信心关系至少0.5,0.7或0.9. 收益在更严格的检查下略有减弱,但即使在最高阈值,在核心文件的召回和关系密度方面都仍然是积极的。 这使得目前的检索结果比纯粹微弱的解释更有力。

blocks.en: C.2.2 Depth Sweep: 1-Hop vs. 2-Hop
blocks.zh: C.2.2 深度扫描:1-Hop对2-Hop

blocks.en: To test whether a deeper traversal helps, we replayed the same retrieval diagnostic with 1-hop and 2-hop expansion. The 2-hop variant does retrieve denser neighborhoods, but it also increases search breadth substantially, lowers unique-paper yield, and slightly weakens community coverage on average. This supports keeping 1-hop as the default while treating 2-hop as an exploratory mode.
blocks.zh: 为了测试一个更深的穿行是否有帮助, 我们用1-hop和2-hop扩展重放同样的检索诊断。 2-hop的变体确实回收了更稠密的街区,但也大大提高了搜索宽度,降低了独特的纸张产量,并平均略微削弱了社区覆盖. 这支持保留 1- hop 作为默认,同时将 2- hop 作为探索模式处理 。

blocks.en: Table A.24: 1-hop vs. 2-hop depth sweep over the same eight archived runs. 2-hop expansion adds coverage inside the graph, but it also pulls in many more nodes and edges and reduces the number of unique papers retained under the fixed retrieval budget.
blocks.zh: 表A.24:1-hop对2-hop深度扫射相同8个存档跑道. 2-hop扩展在图中增加了覆盖范围,但也拉入了更多的节点和边缘,并减少了固定检索预算下保留的独特论文数量.

blocks.en: C.2.3 Relation-Family Ablation
blocks.zh: C.2.3 家庭关系与家庭破裂

blocks.en: To isolate which edge families matter most under the same top- 5 5 section budget, we replayed the 1-hop graph-aware ranker with four relation inventories: the full graph, a no-support variant that removes only generic supports edges, a structural-only variant that keeps support/meta relations but removes evolutionary semantic edges, and a semantic-only variant that keeps only extends / improves / applies / refutes . The result is mixed but informative: dropping generic support edges changes retrieval only slightly, whereas restricting the graph to semantic edges alone degrades both core recall and relation density. This supports the interpretation that the current retrieval gain comes from the combination of structural and semantic links rather than one relation family in isolation.
blocks.zh: 为了孤立哪一个边缘家庭在相同的上- 5 5 款预算下最为重要, 我们重新播放了 1- hop 的图感分级器, 有四个关系目录: 完整的图, 一个只去掉一般支持边缘的无支持变量, 一个只保留支持/meta关系但去掉进化语义边缘的结构变量, 一个只保留延伸 / 改进 / 应用 / 反驳 / 的语义单变量. 结果有好有坏,但资料丰富:降下通用支持边只略微会改变检索,而仅将图形限制在语义边则会降低核心回想和关系密度. 这支持了一种解释,即目前的检索收益来自于结构与语义链接的结合,而不是孤立中的一个关系家族.

blocks.zh: 表A.25:8项存档运行中的关系-家庭检索。 只去除通用支持的边缘会改变平均值小,而只用语义的图形会同时失去核心纸召回和关系密度.

blocks.en: C.3 Core-Score Weight Sensitivity Audit
blocks.zh: C.3 核心分数重量敏感性审计

blocks.en: Because the default core-paper score uses fixed hand-tuned weights, we first ran a local sensitivity audit over the same eight archived MEKGs. We replayed the score with four moderate reweightings (PageRank-heavy, citation-heavy, recency-heavy, and degree-heavy) and found that the overlap with the default top- 10 10 remains 9.0–9.75 papers on average across variants. To address the saved artifacts’ missing citation signal, we then queried OpenAlex for 1,060 unique archived titles, accepted title matches with similarity at least 0.86 and compatible publication year, and recomputed the default score with OpenAlex cited_by_count as a citation proxy. The mean OpenAlex match rate is 92.7%, all eight runs recover nonzero citation signal, and the enriched top- 10 10 overlaps the stored-field top- 10 10 by 6.00 papers on average (range 4–7), indicating that citations materially adjust but do not completely replace the structural/recency ranking.

blocks.en: We then replayed the survey-reference external-core proxy under two stronger OpenAlex-backed settings. Keeping the original score weights but replacing dormant local citation fields with OpenAlex cited_by_count raises mean top- 20 20 proxy recall from 0.162 to 0.189. A second leave-one-run-out coarse-grid calibration over the same proxy reaches 0.289 mean top- 20 20 recall, typically favoring citation-heavy weights (most often 0.7–0.8 on the citation term). The gain is real but not yet decisive: the paired sign test is still weak, and Text-to-SQL Agent collapses under the citation-only optimum selected on the remaining six runs. We therefore treat this replay as evidence that the present score form can be externally calibrated, not as proof that the current scorer is solved.
blocks.zh: 然后在两个更强大的OpenAlex后置设置下重放调查参考外核代用. 保留原有的分数权重,但用 OpenAlex 引用_by_counts 来取代休眠的本地引用字段,提高了20个代理召回率,从0.162到0.189. 在同一代名词上的第二次放行-一跑-粗网校正达到0.289个正值,20次召回,通常倾向于引用-重权重(在引用词上通常为0.7-0.8)。 增益是真实的,但不是决定性的:配对的标志测试仍然很薄弱,而文本到SQL Agent在剩余6个跑道上仅选取的引文最佳下倒闭. 因此,我们把这一回放作为可以将目前的分数表外部校正的证据,而不是作为当前分数表解的证明.

blocks.en: Table A.27: OpenAlex-backed external-core proxy calibration over the seven archived runs with usable survey-reference targets. Replacing dormant local citation fields with OpenAlex cited_by_count gives a small default gain, while leave-one-run-out coarse-grid tuning yields a larger but still explicitly proxy-bound improvement.
blocks.zh: 表A.27:OpenAlex支持的外核代用校正,在7个存档运行时带有可用的调查参考目标。 以 OpenAlex 引用_by_counts 取代休眠本地引用字段可带来一个小的默认收益,而留一跑出粗网格调制则产生更大但明确代理约束的改进.

blocks.en: C.4 Archived Input / Title-Integrity Audit
blocks.zh: C.4 存档输入/标题-完整性审计

blocks.en: Because graph size or relation counts could potentially be inflated by trivial upstream duplication, we ran an additional audit directly over the archived MEKG paper/relation stores. This check is intentionally narrow: it does not claim full scholarly canonicalization, but it asks whether the saved runs exhibit obvious failure modes that should have been caught before any semantic interpretation.
blocks.zh: 由于图大小或关系计数可能因微不足道的上游重复而被夸大,我们直接对存档的MEKG纸/关系商店进行了额外审计。 这种检查是有意的狭隘的:它并不主张完全的学术学说化,但它询问所保存的跑道是否显示出明显的失败模式,这些模式本应在任何语义解释之前被抓住。

blocks.en: Across the eight archived runs, the saved MEKG inputs contain 1,146 paper records and 18,160 relation records. Using the same lightweight title normalization rule implemented in the repository’s online fetcher (lowercasing, punctuation stripping, and whitespace collapsing before title-hash deduplication), we found zero within-run exact title duplicates and zero within-run normalized-title duplicates. We also found zero missing values for the core paper fields we rely on in this paper ( id , title , abstract , category , subcategory , year , source ), zero missing source / target / type / confidence fields in the saved relation records, and zero dangling relation endpoints whose source or target paper ID is absent from the corresponding archived paper store. Relation confidence values in this archive slice range from 0.4 to 1.0, with a global mean of 0.806.
blocks.zh: 在存档的8个记录中,保存的MEKG输入包含1,146个纸质记录和18,160个关系记录。 使用同样在存储器在线获取器中执行的轻量级标题正常化规则(低价、平价剥离和白地空间在标题-hash分级之前崩溃),我们发现运行中的确切标题重复为零,运行中的统一标题重复为零。 我们还发现,在本文中我们所依赖的核心文件字段(id,标题,抽象,类别,子类,年份,来源)中,零缺失值,在所保存的关系记录中,零缺失源 / 目标 / 类型 / 信任字段,零忽略关系端点,其来源或目标纸 ID在相应的存档纸库中缺失. 此档案片中的关系置信值从0.4到1.0不等,全球平均值为0.806.

blocks.en: To clarify why some smaller runs still expose more than 2,300 relations, we also grouped the archived artifacts by corpus size and summarized relation density. The key pattern is that the 50-paper runs are denser in relations per paper , not because of duplicate paper rows, but because compact corpora accumulate many repeated structural/meta links. In particular, the three high-frequency non-semantic types supports , same_author , and shares_architecture already account for roughly 69% of edges in both small and large groups, while semantic edges remain a minority.
blocks.zh: 为了澄清为什么一些较小的跑道仍然暴露出超过2300个关系,我们还按体积和关系密度汇总了存档文物。 关键模式是50相纸运行在每张纸的关系上更密集,这并非因为纸行重复,而是因为Contract Corpora积累了许多重复的结构/meta链接. 特别是,三种高频非语义类型支持 ,同_作者,和sup_architecture 已经占了大小群体边缘的大约69%,而语义边缘仍然是少数.

blocks.en: Table A.28: Grouped relation-density summary for the archived MEKG artifacts. Smaller 50-paper runs are denser in raw relations per paper, but the density is dominated by repeated structural/meta links rather than by a larger semantic-edge share.
blocks.zh: 表A.28 存档的MEKG文物的分类关系密度汇总. 更小的50相纸跑在每张纸的原始关系上较为密集,但密度被反复的结构/元链接所主导,而不是更大的语义-尖端共享.

blocks.en: This audit should be interpreted conservatively. It does not show that all synonymy or cross-run aliasing problems are solved, and it does not validate the semantic correctness of the edges themselves. What it does show is that, within each archived run used in this paper, the graph is not being trivially enlarged by exact duplicate rows, normalized-title duplicates, or broken relation references.
blocks.zh: 这一审计应作保守解释。 它没有显示所有同义词或交叉运行的别名问题都得到了解决,也没有验证边缘本身的语义正确性. 它所显示的是,在本文使用的每个存档运行中,图表并没有被精确的重复行,正统的标题重复,或断开的关系引用所略作扩展.

blocks.en: C.5 Semantic-Edge Consistency Audit
blocks.zh: C.5 语义一致性审计

blocks.en: We further audited the semantic edge types most central to MEKG’s evolutionary claims: extends , improves , and applies . For each archived edge, we checked whether the source paper is temporally at least as recent as the target paper, whether the source title/abstract contains an explicit lexical cue compatible with the relation type, and what confidence score was saved in the archived relation record. This remains a consistency audit rather than a human-annotated precision/recall study.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步审核了对于MEKG进化主张最关键的语义边缘类型:扩展、改进和适用。 对于每一个已存档的边缘,我们检查了源文件的时间是否至少与目标文件相近,源标题/摘要是否包含一个与关系类型相容的明确的词典提示,以及存档关系记录中保存了哪些信任分. 这仍然是一个一致性审计,而不是人为的精确/回顾研究。

blocks.en: Table A.29: Archived semantic-edge consistency audit over 2,091 MEKG edges. High temporal-direction consistency supports the intended evolutionary orientation, while the lower cue-support rates indicate that many saved edges rely on contextual inference rather than only keyword matching.
blocks.zh: 表A.29:2,091个MEKG边缘的已归档语义前沿一致性审计. 高时间-方向一致性支持了所要的演化取向,而下提示支持率则表明许多被保存的边缘依赖于上下文推论,而不只是关键词相匹配.

blocks.en: C.5.1 Semantic-Edge Negative-Control Audit
blocks.zh: C.5.1 语义学-Edge 负控制审计

blocks.en: The consistency checks above still do not answer whether the saved semantic edges are distinguishable from plausible non-edges. We therefore added a deterministic negative-control audit over the same 2,091 archived extends / improves / applies edges. For each observed edge, we compared source–target lexical overlap against two controls from the same archived run: a matched non-edge with compatible temporal direction and target-role class, and an intentionally easy non-edge chosen to have minimal lexical overlap with the source. This design uses no new model calls and is deliberately conservative: the matched control is meant to be hard, not a strawman.
blocks.zh: 以上一致性检查仍然无法回答所保存的语义边缘与可能存在的非对角边缘是否可以区分. 因此,我们增加了对同样2 091个存档延伸/改进/应用边线的确定性负控制审计。 对于每个观测到的边缘,我们比较了源-目标语法重叠与同一存档运行的两个控件:一个匹配的非对接,具有相容的时间取向和目标-作用类,以及一个有意选择的简单非对接,与源语法重叠最小。 这种设计没有使用新的型号调用,并刻意保守:相匹配的控制本意是硬的,而不是吸管.

blocks.en: Table A.30: Semantic-edge negative-control audit using lexical overlap. Observed semantic edges are clearly separated from arbitrary low-overlap non-edges, but they are nearly tied with temporally and target-role matched non-edge controls. This negative result supports our conservative interpretation that lexical evidence alone cannot validate extends / improves / applies edges.
blocks.zh: 表A.30:使用词典重叠的语义-尖端负控制审计. 被观测到的语义边缘显然与任意的低倾覆非对角相分离,但它们几乎被时间和目标作用相匹配的非对角控制所捆绑. 这一负面结果支持了我们的保守解释,即单凭词汇证据无法验证延伸/改进/应用边.

blocks.en: At the run level, the easy-control contrast is positive in 8/8 runs (one-sided sign-flip p = 0.0039 p=0.0039 ), while the matched-control contrast is positive in only 5/8 runs (one-sided p = 0.1719 p=0.1719 ). By relation type, extends and improves are slightly above matched controls on average, whereas applies is slightly below matched controls. We therefore do not use this audit to claim semantic precision. Its value is diagnostic: it rules out completely arbitrary low-overlap links, but confirms that a benchmark-grade edge study needs human labels, citation-context spans, and negative sampling beyond local lexical overlap.
blocks.zh: 在跑道级别上,8/8跑道的易控对比为正(单侧标志-飞行p=0.0039p=0.0039),而相配的控制对比为正(单侧标志-飞行p=0.1719p=0.1719). 按关系类型,延伸和改进程度略高于平均匹配控制,而适用程度略低于匹配控制。 因此,我们不利用这项审计来声称语义精确。 其价值是诊断性:它排除了完全任意的低覆叠接环节,但确认基准级边缘研究需要人类标签,引用-背景跨度,负面采样超越了本地词汇重叠.

blocks.en: C.5.2 Confidence-Stratified Semantic-Edge Profile
blocks.zh: C.5.2 信心分级语义语义学简介

blocks.en: To test whether the archived confidence scores align with local textual evidence, we add one more zero-cost profile over the same 2,091 semantic edges. We pruned the archived semantic layer to edges with confidence at least 0.5, 0.7, or 0.9 and recomputed the same consistency statistics. The result is modest but still informative: higher-confidence subsets retain near-perfect temporal direction, and explicit source-cue support rises slightly from 32.0% at ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 to 33.2% at ≥ 0.7 \geq 0.7 before becoming sample-limited at ≥ 0.9 \geq 0.9 (52 edges total). We therefore interpret the saved confidence field as a useful but still imperfect diagnostic priority signal rather than as calibrated probabilistic correctness.
blocks.zh: 为了测试存档的置信分数是否与当地文字证据一致,我们在同一2,091个语义边上再增加一个零成本剖面. 我们把存档的语义层推向了至少有0.5、0.7或0.9信心的边缘,并重编了同样的一致性统计。 结果是适度的,但信息仍然丰富:高自信子集保留了接近完美的时间方向,明确的源- cue 支持从32.0% ~ 0.5\ geq 0.5到33.2% ~ 0.7\ geq 0.7,然后在0.9\ geq 0.9成为样本限制(共52个边缘). 因此,我们把节省下来的信任领域解释为一个有用但仍然不完善的诊断优先信号,而不是校正概率正确性。

blocks.en: Table A.31: Confidence-stratified semantic-edge consistency profile over the archived MEKG. Higher-confidence subsets retain near-perfect temporal direction, while explicit lexical cue support rises only modestly, which supports treating confidence as a diagnostic ranking signal rather than as a calibrated correctness score.
blocks.zh: 表A.31: 与存档的MEKG相比,具有信心的语义前沿一致性简介。 高自信子集保留了接近完美的时间取向,而明确的语法提示支持只略有提升,支持将信心作为诊断排名信号而非校正正确分数来对待.

blocks.en: C.5.3 Repeated-Protocol Semantic-Edge Audit
blocks.zh: C.5.3 重复的议定书语义审计

blocks.en: To add an extra sanity check without running a full human study, we expanded the semantic-edge check into a stratified repeated-protocol audit with 72 rows stratified by relation type and confidence bucket (24 each for extends , improves , and applies ; 24 each for low/mid/high confidence). Unlike the earlier 36-row author-side audit, this extension uses a deterministic protocol over archived artifacts: each sampled row is assigned a support tier from temporal direction, source-side lexical cue support, target-role admissibility, and whether the observed edge beats a temporally and role-matched non-edge control in lexical overlap. This remains a zero-API deterministic audit rather than a human precision/recall study, but it is stricter and more reproducible than the earlier spot check.
blocks.zh: 为了在不进行完整的人文研究的情况下增加额外的疗养检查,我们把语义-尖端检查扩展为分级的重复-protocol审计,按关系类型和信心桶分出72行(每行24行用于延长、改进和适用;24行用于低/中/高信心)。 与之前的36行作者-侧面审计不同,这个扩展使用对存档文物的定时协议:每个被样本行被分配到从时间方向,源侧词典提示支持,目标作用可接受性,以及被观测到的边缘是否在词典重叠中比照时间和角色相匹配的非对角控制. 这仍然是零API确定性审计,而不是人力精确/召回研究,但比早先的抽查更严格更可复制.

blocks.en: Table A.32: Stratified repeated-protocol audit over 72 stratified semantic-edge rows. The protocol is deterministic and stricter than the earlier author-side spot audit, so the lower support rate should be read as a more conservative view of semantic-edge reliability rather than as contradictory evidence.
blocks.zh: 表A.32:72个分级语义尖端行的分级重复议定书审计。 协议是决定性的,比早期的作者-侧即时审计更严格,因此较低的支持率应该被解读为对语义尖端可靠性的更保守的观点,而不是自相矛盾的证据.

blocks.en: In this stricter 72-row audit, the supported-or-partial rate is 61.1% overall. By relation type, improves is the strongest at 70.8%, applies reaches 66.7%, and extends is weakest at 45.8%. The dominant failure modes are missing explicit source cues (18 rows), weak lineage signal under the matched-control contrast (17), lexical overlap not better than the matched control despite otherwise admissible roles/time (14), and target-role mismatch (10). Only one sampled row is a temporal reversal. By confidence bucket, the low and high buckets each reach 66.7% supported-or-partial, while the mid bucket is weaker at 54.2%, reinforcing our interpretation that the archived confidence field is at best a rough priority signal rather than a calibrated correctness estimate.
blocks.zh: 在这一更严格的72行审计中,支助或部分支助比率为61.1%。 按关系类型来看,改善幅度最大,为70.8%,应用率达到66.7%,扩展率最弱,为45.8%。 主要的失败模式是缺少明确的源提示(18行),匹配-控制对比下的分界线信号薄弱(17),词汇重叠不优于匹配控制,尽管本来可以接受角色/时间(14),以及目标-作用不匹配(10). 只有一行样本是时间倒置. 通过信心桶,低和高的桶子各达到66.7%的支持-或部分,而中间的桶子更弱到54.2%,强化了我们的解释,即存档的自信场充其量是一个粗糙的优先信号,而不是校正的正确性估计.

blocks.en: To make the protocol less abstract, Table A.33 shows representative passed, partial, and failed cases with snippets extracted from paper metadata fields. These examples are not additional human labels; they illustrate why we treat semantic edges as candidate evidence. Supported cases usually contain source-side method or adaptation cues and beat the matched non-edge control, while failed cases often point from a method paper to a benchmark/dataset target or have only generic topical overlap.
blocks.zh: 为了减少协议的抽象度,表A.33用从纸质元数据字段中提取的片断显示代表性通过,部分和失败的大小写. 这些例子并不是额外的人类标签;它们说明了我们为什么把语义边缘当作候选证据. 所支持的案例通常包含源侧方法或适应提示并击败相匹配的非对角控制,而失败的案例往往从方法纸指向基准/数据集目标,或者只有通用主题重叠.

blocks.en: Table A.33: Representative semantic-edge examples from the snippet audit. The table illustrates both positive and negative protocol decisions and motivates the evidence-gated replay in Table A.41 .
blocks.zh: 表A.33:片段审计中具有代表性的语义尖端实例。 该表说明了协议的正反两个决定,并激励表A.41中循证重放。

blocks.en: C.5.4 Generated-Claim Citation-Support and Lexical Anchor Audits
blocks.zh: C.5.4 生成 -- -- 索偿 -- -- 支助和表征 -- -- 审计

blocks.en: Because grounding ultimately depends on generated survey statements rather than only graph edges, we expanded the earlier two-topic spot check into a deterministic lexical-anchor audit over eight archived SurveyGraph outputs. The expanded audit samples 20 cited body sentences per run (160 sentences total), including both single- and multi-citation sentences, and compares each sentence with cited paper titles, abstracts, and cached text. The labels are anchored , partial , or weak/missing ; they are lexical grounding triage rather than blinded human citation-faithfulness annotation.
blocks.zh: 由于地面最终取决于生成的调查报表,而不仅仅是图边,我们把早先的两个专题的即时检查扩大到了对存档的8个SurveyGraph产出的确定语法-定点审计。 扩大的审计样本为每跑20个引用的正文句(共计160个句子),包括单句和多句引用的句子,并将每句与被引用的纸上标题,摘要和缓存文本进行比较. 标签是固定的,部分的,或者弱/缺失的;它们属于语法上的打地分法,而不是盲目的人类引用-信仰注释.

blocks.en: Table A.34: Expanded claim-to-citation lexical anchor audit over eight archived generated surveys. The overall anchored-or-partial rate is 129/160 = 80.6%, with 103 single-citation and 57 multi-citation sentences. Weak/missing-anchor rows mark higher-risk claims for manual review rather than automatic hallucination labels.
blocks.zh: 表A.34:扩大对8起存档调查的债权与引用法锚地审计。 总的锚定率为129/160=80.6%,其中103个是单引句,57个是多引句. 薄弱/缺失-锁定行标标出高风险索赔要求进行人工审查,而不是自动幻觉标签.

blocks.en: For continuity with earlier checks, we also keep the smaller two-topic author-side spot audit: 24 single-citation body sentences from the archived DocQA and Text-to-SQL artifacts yielded 15 supported, 7 partial, and 2 unsupported cases (91.7% supported-or-partial). The expanded 160-sentence audit is intentionally stricter and broader, so we use the 80.6% lexical anchored-or-partial rate as the safer headline. Together, the audits suggest that many generated cited statements have local evidence anchors, while over-specific implementation or formalization claims remain the dominant risk when retrieved evidence is thin.
blocks.zh: 为了保持早期检查的连续性,我们还保留了规模较小的双专题作者侧即时审计:存档的DocQA和Text-to-SQL文物中的24个单引用体句,共获得15个支持,7个部分支持,2个不支持(91.7%支持-或部分支持). 扩大的160级判决审计是有意的,更加严格和广泛,因此我们使用80.6%的词汇定位率或部分率作为更安全的标题. 审计表明,许多援引的报表都以当地证据为主,而过于具体的执行或正式化索赔仍然是主要风险,因为收回的证据很少。

blocks.en: We further ran a zero-API semantic-support probe over the same 160 cited sentences using a locally cached bge-small-en-v1.5 encoder. A title-only semantic threshold is too permissive: all 160 sentences are labelled semantic-supported-or-partial when compared only with their cited paper titles. To make the check harder, we add a hard-negative control that compares each sentence against non-cited titles from the same topic pool. Under this control, the cited title beats the hard negative in only 72/160 cases (45.0%), with a mean cited-minus-negative margin of -0.003. This negative result is useful: title-level semantic similarity is not a reliable substitute for citation faithfulness, so the lexical audit should remain a triage tool and future evaluation should use citation-context spans, full abstracts, NLI, or human labels.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个本地缓存的bge- small-en-v1.5编码器 在同一160个引用的句子上运行了一个零API语义支持探测器. 只有标题的语义阈值是太放任自流的:所有160个句子都标有语义支持-或部分(仅与所引用的纸张标题作比较). 为了更严格地检查,我们增加了一个硬阴性控制,将每个句子与来自同一主题集合的非引用标题进行比较. 在这种控制下,被引用的标题仅以72/160个案例(45.0%)击败了硬负数,平均引用负比为-0.003。 这种负面的结果是有用的:标题层次的语义相似性不能可靠地取代引用的忠实性,因此,词典审计应该仍然是分门别类的工具,未来的评价应该使用引用-语义跨度,全摘要,NLI,或者人类的标签.

blocks.en: Table A.35: Citation semantic-support probe with hard negatives. Scores use a locally cached BGE encoder over generated cited sentences and cited/non-cited paper titles. The hard-negative result prevents us from treating title-level semantic similarity as citation faithfulness.
blocks.zh: 表A.35:带有硬底片的引用语义支持探测器. 分数使用本地缓存的 BGE 编码器多于生成的引用句和引用/未引用的纸张标题 。 硬否定的结果使我们无法将标题层次的语义相似性视为引用忠实.

blocks.en: Because title-only contrast is weak, we also ran an evidence-level hard-negative probe. For each cited sentence with a recoverable arXiv identifier, we matched the citation key back to the archived paper record and compared the generated sentence against the cited paper’s title, abstract, and first local text span. The hard negative is drawn from non-cited papers in the same archived run. This stronger local-evidence contrast covers 159/160 sampled sentences. Overall, the cited evidence beats the hard negative in 104/159 cases (65.4%), with the anchored lexical group strongest (71.7%) and weak/missing lexical rows near chance (48.4%). This supports the lexical audit’s ranking signal while still falling short of a full faithfulness judgment.
blocks.zh: 因为只有所有权的对比度很弱,我们还运行了一个证据级硬阴性探测器. 对于每个引用的有可收回的arXiv标识的句子,我们把引用键与存档的纸质记录相匹配,并将生成的句子与被引用的纸质标题、抽象和第一个本地文本跨度相比较。 硬负数取自同一存档运行中未引用的论文. 这种较强的本地证据对比涵盖159/160个抽样判决。 总的来说,引用的证据在104/159个案件中(65.4%)击败了硬负数,锚定语系群最强(71.7%),弱/缺失语系行近乎偶然(48.4%)。 这支持了词典审计的排名信号,同时仍然没有完全忠实的判断.

blocks.en: Table A.36: Evidence-level citation contrast using archived cited-paper title, abstract, and local text against same-run hard negatives. The contrast is stronger than title-only matching and shows that lexical weak/missing rows are also weaker under evidence-level comparison.
blocks.zh: 表A.36:证据级引文对比,采用存档的被引用文件标题,抽象,本地文本与同运行的硬底. 对比性比只标标题匹配更强,并显示在证据级比较下,词汇弱/缺失行也更弱.

blocks.en: C.5.5 Section-Reference Alignment Audit
blocks.zh: C.5.5 该科与参考统一审计

blocks.en: To complement claim-level checks and the brittle graph-internal structural-coherence metric, we added a section-reference alignment diagnostic over the same archived generated surveys. For each top-level generated section, the script aggregates the locally cached evidence behind that section’s citations and computes a conservative lexical-overlap precision. This is not semantic entailment, but it checks whether sections carry local citation evidence instead of being uncited narrative filler.
blocks.zh: 为了补充索赔一级的检查和Brittle Graph-Introduction-Coordence的衡量标准,我们在同一档案生成的调查中增加了一节参照统一诊断。 对于每个顶级生成的区块,脚本会汇总该区块引用后本地缓存的证据并计算出保守的词典-重叠精度. 这不是语义上的暗示,而是检查各节是否带有当地引用证据,而不是未引用的叙事填充词.

blocks.en: Table A.37: Section-reference alignment audit over 42 top-level sections from eight archived generated surveys. All sections have citations; 85.7% are aligned-or-partial under the conservative lexical proxy, and the uncited-section rate is 0.0%.
blocks.zh: 表A.37:对8个存档生成的调查中42个顶级科室的科级统一审计。 所有章节都有引用;85.7%在保守的词汇代理下对齐或部分对齐,未引用的段落率为0.00%.

blocks.en: C.6 Survey-Reference External-Core Audit
blocks.zh: C.6 调查-参考 外部-核心审计

blocks.en: The archived retrieval diagnostic risks circularity because it evaluates core-paper recall against a core set derived from the same MEKG. To partially reduce this coupling without paying for new public-benchmark runs, we built one weak external-core proxy directly from the archived corpora. For each archived run, we scanned local survey/review paper JSON files, extracted arXiv identifiers mentioned in their reference text, and intersected those identifiers with the same run’s archived paper pool. This yields a survey-reference-backed target set that is not chosen by the MEKG core scorer itself, although it remains an archive-internal proxy rather than a public benchmark.
blocks.zh: 存档的检索诊断风险循环,因为它根据同一MEKG得出的一套核心数据对核心文件召回进行评价。 为了在不支付新的公共基准运行费用的情况下部分减少这种接合,我们从存档的Corpora直接建立了一个薄弱的外部核心代理. 每一次存档运行,我们扫描了本地调查/审查文件JSON,提取了参考文本中提到的arXiv标识符,并将这些标识符与同一运行的存档纸库相交. 这产生了一套调查参考支持的目标,不是MEKG核心计分员自己选择的,尽管它仍然是一个存档-内部代用,而不是公共基准.

blocks.en: Seven archived runs expose at least three such target papers. Across those seven runs, the mean proxy size is 12.43 papers (median 13), with 7.43 local survey/review sources contributing on average. The default hybrid core score recovers only 5.8% of these targets in its top-10 and 16.2% in its top-20. For context, pure recency reaches 17.9% top-20 recall and pure PageRank 17.3%. In other words, this audit does not show external-core strength; rather, it quantifies that the current core-paper scorer still aligns weakly with even a weak survey-reference proxy. We include this negative result because it directly answers the circularity criticism with real local evidence instead of leaving the issue implicit.
blocks.zh: 7份档案显示至少3份此类目标文件。 在这7起事件中,平均代理规模为12.43起(中间13起),平均有7.43起当地调查/审查来源。 默认混合核心分数在其前-10和前-20中分别只恢复了5.8%和16.2%的这些目标. 就上下文而言,纯度达到了17.9%的上20回想和纯度的PageRank 17.3%. 换句话说,这次审计并不显示外部核心优势;相反,它可以量化的是,目前的核心文件记分员仍然与即使是一个薄弱的调查参考代用词也相去甚远。 我们列入了这一负面结果,因为它直接用真正的当地证据来回答循环性的批评,而不是把问题隐含起来。

blocks.en: Table A.38: Survey-reference external-core proxy audit over seven archived runs. The proxy is built from local survey/review references rather than from the MEKG core scorer, so the default recall remains low and makes the current circularity limitation explicit; the OpenAlex calibration above shows that some of this gap is tied to dormant citation fields rather than to graph structure alone.
blocks.zh: 表A.38:7次存档审计的调查参考外部核心代理审计。 代理由本地调查/审查参考而来,而不是由MEKG核心计分器来构建,因此默认召回仍然很低并使得当前循环限制明确;上方的OpenAlex校正显示,这一缺口中有一些与休眠引用字段相接而来,而不是仅与图形结构相接.

blocks.en: We also replayed the relation-family ablation against this weaker external proxy rather than only against the internal MEKG-derived core set. The result is mixed but informative. On mean top- 5 5 recall, the full graph reaches 0.153, no-support reaches 0.221, structural-only reaches 0.135, and semantic-only reaches 0.266. However, semantic-only retrieval sharply lowers relation density from 0.230 to 0.091 (paired two-sided p = 0.0156 p=0.0156 ), while no-support also lowers density slightly but consistently (0.230 → \rightarrow 0.215; p = 0.0469 p=0.0469 ). We therefore do not claim a single winning family: the weak external proxy suggests that semantic edges contribute much of the target-hit signal, whereas structural/meta edges preserve denser and more internally connected retrieved sets.
blocks.zh: 我们还重播了针对这个较弱的外部代理而不仅仅针对内部的MEKG派生核心集的亲子关系衰减. 结果好坏参半,但资料丰富。 在平均上 -- 5 5 回想时,全图达到0.153,无支持达到0.221,结构上仅达到0.135,语义上仅达到0.266. 然而,只读语义的检索密度从0.230到0.091急剧降低(双侧页=0.0156 p=0.0156),而无支持度也略微但持续地降低密度(0.230 →\正线0.215;p=0.0469 p=0.0469),因此我们并不主张一个单一的胜出家族:弱的外接代表表示语义边缘贡献了目标打击信号的大部分,而结构/元边缘则保留了更密集和更内部连接的检索器.

blocks.en: Table A.39: Relation-family replay against the weaker survey-reference external proxy. Semantic-only retrieval gives the highest weak-target hit rate, but it also sharply reduces relation density and the size of the active neighborhood, which supports a mixed-family interpretation of the current retrieval scaffold.
blocks.zh: 表A.39:关系-家庭对照较弱的调查-参考外部代理重放. 语义上唯取取(semantic- only reference)给出了最高的弱目标命中率,但同时也会急剧地降低关系密度和活跃街区的大小,这支持了对当前取回脚手架的混合家庭解释.

It gives a more conservative picture than the four-topic matched gate below: supported/partial gating removes 102.6 semantic edges per run on average and slightly raises precision, but it does not reproduce the four-topic recall gain. This is why the main text treats semantic gating as useful pruning rather than as a universal recall improver.

Semantic-only retrieval gives the highest weak-target recall but the lowest relation density; supported/partial gating removes noisy semantic candidates while preserving weak-proxy behavior within small margins of the full graph.
blocks.zh: 表A.40:扩展七运行外置代管关系-家族和语义门重放. 唯语义检索给出了最高的弱-目标回想,但关系密度最低;支持/部分格特删除了吵闹的语义考生,同时在全图的小边框内保留了弱-副作用.

blocks.en: C.7 Semantic Evidence-Gated Retrieval Replay on Four Matched Topics
blocks.zh: C.7 语义证据 - 检索四个相匹配主题上的回放

blocks.en: The repeated-protocol audit above gives labels but does not by itself show whether those labels are useful operationally. We therefore reran the four-topic matched retrieval-stage comparison after converting the deterministic protocol labels into a cheap evidence gate. Non-semantic edges are kept; semantic edges are either kept only when labelled supported-or-partial, kept only when labelled supported, or dropped entirely in the structural-only variant. This replay uses the same archived outlines, same top- 5 5 per-section budget, and same survey-reference external proxy as the matched simpler-graph baseline.
blocks.zh: 上面的重复议定书审计给出了标签,但本身并不表明这些标签在业务上是否有用。 因此,我们在将确定性协议标签转换成廉价证据门后,重新提出四个主题对应的检索阶段比较。 非语义边被保留;语义边要么只保留被标记为被支持-或部分被保留,要么只保留被标记为被支持被保留,或者完全被降入结构上唯一的变体. 此回放使用相同的存档大纲,每个款次预算的上-5 5,以及匹配的更简单的图表基线相同的调查参考外部代理.

blocks.en: Table A.41: Semantic evidence-gated retrieval replay over four matched topics. In this four-topic matched slice, the supported/partial gate drops an average of 103.0 candidate semantic edges per topic and improves the weak external-proxy recall and precision while preserving relation density; Table A.40 reports the more conservative seven-run replay. This supports using semantic-edge audits as a lightweight verification gate, but the four-topic sample remains too small for a benchmark claim.
blocks.zh: 表A.41:语义学证据检索重放四个对应专题。 在这个四个主题匹配的切片中,被支持/部分的门平均会减少每个主题的103.0个候选语义边并改进弱的外置-代词回想和精度,同时保持关系密度; 表A.40报告比较保守的七跑重放. 这支持将语义尖端审计作为轻量级的核查门,但四个专题样本对于基准索赔来说仍然太小。

blocks.en: The gate result is directionally useful but deliberately modest. It does not prove that the deterministic protocol is a calibrated semantic-edge verifier. Instead, it shows that the failure modes identified by the audit are not merely descriptive: filtering edges that fail the protocol can improve the same retrieval-stage proxy. This strengthens the paper’s narrower claim that MEKG relations are useful when treated as ranked, auditable candidate evidence rather than as unquestioned lineage facts.
blocks.zh: 大门结果在方向上有用,但刻意适度。 无法证明确定性协议是校正语义-尖端验证器. 相反,它表明审计所发现的失败模式并不仅仅是描述性的:过滤失败协议的边缘可以改进相同的检索阶段代用. 这强化了该报的狭隘说法,即MEKG关系在作为有排名的、可审计的候选证据而不是毫无疑问的世系事实对待时是有用的。

blocks.en: We also applied the same deterministic protocol to all 2,091 archived semantic candidate edges, not only to the stratified 72-row sample. This full-protocol replay is still automatic, but it clarifies which errors the gate is actually suppressing at scale. Overall, 338 edges are labelled supported, 891 partial, and 862 unsupported, for a 58.8% supported-or-partial rate. The weakest relation is extends : it has 1,276 candidates, only 52.4% supported-or-partial, and most unsupported cases are weak-lineage or target-role errors. improves is stronger (80.6% supported-or-partial), while applies remains intermediate (59.0%). Among unsupported cases, weak lineage signal accounts for 616 rows, target-role mismatch for 234, and temporal reversal for 12. This explains why the supported/partial retrieval gate improves the matched proxy: it removes a large set of noisy semantic candidates while leaving non-semantic structure untouched. In a fixed top- 5 5 ranking, removing a high-ranked unsupported candidate can increase recall by freeing a slot for a proxy-target paper; this occurs on the memory topic, while recall is exactly tied on the other three topics.
blocks.zh: 我们还对所有2,091个存档语义候选边适用同样的确定性协议,不仅适用于分级的72行样本。 这款全相机回放仍然是自动的,但它澄清了闸门实际上在规模上压制哪些出错. 总体而言,有338个边缘被贴上标签,891个部分,862个不贴上标签,占58.8%的支持率或部分比例。 关系最薄弱的是扩展:它有1 276名候选人,只有52.4%得到支持或部分得到支持,大多数没有得到支持的案例是弱线或目标作用错误。 改善幅度更大(80.6%得到支持或部分支持),而适用程度仍然是中间的(59.0%)。 在无支持的病例中,弱行信号占了616行,目标-作用不匹配234个,时间倒转12个. 这解释了为什么支持/部分取取出门改进了匹配的代理:它删除了一大批吵闹的语义学考生,同时使非语义结构未受影响. 在固定的上-5 5名排名中,去掉一个名列前茅的无支持候选人可以通过为代理目标纸腾出一个档位来增加召回;这发生在内存话题上,而召回则与其他三个话题完全挂钩.

blocks.en: Table A.42: Full deterministic semantic-gate replay over all archived semantic candidate edges. The protocol is automatic rather than human annotation, but it identifies the same brittleness identified by the audits: extends is the noisiest semantic relation, whereas improves has stronger local evidence.
blocks.zh: 表A.42: 经常预算 完全确定语义门重放 在所有存档语义候选边缘。 协议是自动的,而不是人类的注释,但它确定了审计所查明的同样不易之处:延伸是最出名的语义关系,而改进则有更强有力的当地证据。

blocks.en: The released annotation artifacts separate two files: (i) a reusable blinded packet with blank label columns and guidelines, and (ii) the filled adjudicated-label file used for the reported 108-edge human validation. Table A.43 reports the filled adjudicated labels, not the deterministic reference labels; the blank packet is included only to support independent reuse of the annotation protocol.
blocks.zh: 公布的注释文物将两个文件分开:(一) 带有空白标签栏和准则的可重复使用的盲文包;和(二) 用于所报告的108个尖端人类验证的已填好的裁定标签文件。 表A.43报告已填好的裁定标签,而不是确定性参考标签;空白包仅用于支持独立再使用注解协议。

blocks.en: Table A.43: Adjudicated human labels for the 108-edge semantic-edge validation packet. S/P denotes supported-or-partial. Binary support agreement is Cohen’s κ = 0.64 \kappa{=}0.64 ; three-way labels are used mainly for failure-mode analysis.
blocks.zh: 表A.43:108高端语义-高端验证包的判给人类标签. S/P表示支持或部分支持。 二进制支持协议为Cohen's $ = 0.64\kappa = 0.64; 三向标签主要用于故障-模式分析.

blocks.en: C.8 Encoder-Sensitivity and Graph-Safe Retrieval Fusion
blocks.zh: C.8 编码器-敏感度和图-安全检索

blocks.en: To test encoder sensitivity, we replayed the seven-run survey-reference external proxy with five base rankers: the repository’s existing lexical scorer, word TF-IDF, character TF-IDF, locally cached all-MiniLM-L6-v2 , and locally cached bge-small-en-v1.5 . For each base ranker, we evaluated (i) the base ranker alone and (ii) the same 1-hop graph expansion used by the archived diagnostic. This is a retrieval-stage sensitivity replay only; it does not regenerate surveys or tune prompts.
blocks.zh: 为了测试编码器的敏感性,我们用5个底号重新播放了7个运行的勘测参考外部代理:寄存器的现有词典计分器,单词为TF-IDF,字符为TF-IDF,本地缓存为全-MiniLM-L6-v2,本地缓存为bge- small-en-v1.5. 对于每个基座分级器,我们评价了(一) 仅基座分级器和(二) 存档诊断所用的相同的一跳图扩展. 这仅仅是一个检索阶段的敏感性再播放;它不会再生成调查或调子提示.

blocks.en: Table A.44: Seven-run encoder-sensitivity replay against the weak survey-reference external proxy. Unconstrained 1-hop graph expansion consistently increases relation density, but it can lower proxy recall by over-expanding away from strong lexical or dense anchors. This is a cautionary result, not a failure to report.
blocks.zh: 表A.44:7运行编码器灵敏度与弱调查参考外部代理重放. 不受约束的一跳图扩展持续地提高关系密度,但可以通过过度扩展远离强力的词典或密集锚来降低代理召回. 这是一个谨慎的结果,而不是不报告。

blocks.en: Because this replay revealed an over-expansion risk, we ran a second sweep that preserves the top base-ranked anchors before filling the rest of the top- 5 5 budget with graph-neighbor candidates. Table A.45 reports the best high-density setting whose recall stays within 95% of the base-only recall. The result is useful but nuanced. Anchor-preserving graph fusion is helpful for the existing lexical scorer and BGE, and less useful for the two TF-IDF variants where the base ranker already dominates this weak proxy. This gives a concrete default for future retrieval: graph expansion should be anchor-preserving or budget-aware, not an unconstrained replacement for the base ranker.
blocks.zh: 因为这次重播揭示出过度扩张的风险,我们进行了第二次扫荡,在用相邻的图表候选人来填补前5个5个预算的其余部分之前,保留了排名最高的主播. 表A.45报告最高密度设定,其召回率保持在基准召回率的95%以内。 结果有用但细微. Anchor-Pleator图聚变对现有的词典计分器和BGE很有帮助,对基础分级器已经主导了这个弱代词的两个TF-IDF变体则用处较小. 这为未来的检索提供了具体的默认:图的扩展应该是锚地-保留或预算-意识到,而不是一个不受限制的基位分级器的替换.

blocks.en: Table A.45: Anchor-preserving graph-fusion sweep. The reported mode is the highest-density setting whose recall remains at least 95% of the base-only recall. For BGE and the existing lexical ranker, safe graph fusion raises relation density substantially without materially reducing the weak external-proxy recall.
blocks.zh: 表A.45: 锁定-保存图聚扫描. 报告模式是密度最高的设定,其召回率至少为基准召回的95%。 对于BGE和现有的词典分级器来说,安全的图聚会大大提高关系密度,而不会在物质上降低弱的外置-代用重排.

blocks.en: C.9 Semantic Target-Role Pruning Audit
blocks.zh: C.9 语义学目标审计

blocks.en: The semantic audit highlights a concrete failure mode: some extends / improves edges appear to point to surveys, benchmarks, or datasets rather than to precursor methods. To test whether this issue materially affects the retrieval-side story, we ran one simple heuristic replay over the eight archived runs, reported in the released audit package and local diagnostics. We pruned only extends and improves edges whose target titles match lightweight survey/benchmark/dataset regex cues (e.g., survey , review , benchmark , dataset ), kept all other relation families unchanged, and reran the same 1-hop graph-aware retrieval diagnostic.
blocks.zh: 语义审计突出了一种具体的失败模式:有些延伸/改进边缘似乎指向调查、基准或数据集,而不是前体方法。 为了测试这个问题是否对检索侧面的故事有实质影响,我们用一个简单的heuristic 重放八个存档运行,在公布的审计包和当地诊断中报告。 我们只浏览了与轻量级调查/基准/数据集 regex 提示相匹配的目标标题的边缘(例如,调查、审查、基准、数据集),使所有其他关系家族保持不变,并重新进行相同的1-跳图-知觉检索诊断。

blocks.en: This heuristic removes 10.0% of semantic edges on average across runs. By relation type, it prunes 12.5% of extends edges (160/1276), 4.4% of improves edges (16/366), and none of the applies edges. Importantly, the replay does not hurt the archived retrieval-side picture on average: mean graph core-paper recall rises from 0.373 to 0.395, and mean relation density rises from 0.259 to 0.263. The effect is modest and not yet statistically persuasive under exact sign-flip counting (core-recall deltas: 2 positive, 1 negative, 5 ties), so we do not present this as a full repair. Instead, it is evidence that the target-role mismatch identified above is real, measurable, and partially suppressible with even a very cheap heuristic.
blocks.zh: 这种高uristic平均去除10.0 %的语义边缘横行. 按亲缘关系类型,它将12.5%的延伸边缘(160/1276),4.4%的改进边缘(16/366)并没有任何应用边缘. 重要的是,重播不会平均伤害存档的检索-侧图:正图核心纸召回率从0.373升至0.395;正线关系密度从0.259升至0.263. 其影响不大,在精确的标志-倒计时(核心回顾三角洲:2个正,1个负,5个联系)下,统计上尚不具有说服力,因此我们不将此作为全面修复. 相反,有证据表明,上面确定的目标-作用不匹配是真实的,可以测量的,甚至可以用非常廉价的heuristic来部分抑制.

blocks.en: Table A.46: Semantic target-role pruning replay over the eight archived runs. Pruning likely survey/benchmark/dataset targets from extends / improves removes about one tenth of semantic edges while leaving the retrieval-side diagnostic slightly better on average.
blocks.zh: 表A.46:在存档的8个跑道上进行语义化目标-作用回放. 将可能的勘测/基准/数据集目标从扩展/改进中清除出大约十分之一的语义边缘,同时平均使检索-侧诊断略好。

blocks.en: C.10 Runtime and Token/Cost Traces
blocks.zh: C.10 运行时间和托肯/Cost Tracks

blocks.en: Finally, we aggregated the saved stage timers and token monitors. These traces answer a narrower reproducibility question than a full efficiency benchmark: how long do the currently inspectable runs take, which stage dominates the latency, and what token/cost traces are exposed for the fresh low-cost reruns? The archived full runs have a mean recorded stage sum of 118.91 minutes (median 123.17; range 28.10–262.69), with content generation contributing 92.5% of stage time on average. For the fresh low-cost smoke reruns, the saved token monitors expose provider-side token and cost estimates under the respective run-time pricing configurations. Table A.48 additionally normalizes the archived traces by paper count. We report these numbers mainly to contextualize why the diagnostic additions above were kept fully local and post hoc rather than expanded into another long-form generation campaign.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们汇总了保存的舞台计时器和显示器。 这些痕迹解答了一个比全面效率基准更窄的可复制性问题:目前可检查的跑道要花多长时间,哪个阶段主导了耐久性,以及新的低成本再跑会暴露出什么标志/成本痕迹? 存档的全程平均记录舞台总和为118.91分(中位数为123.17分;范围为28.10至262.69分),内容生成平均贡献舞台时间的92.5%. 对于新鲜的低成本烟雾再运行,所保存的道具显示器揭示了各道跑道时间定价配置下供方道具和成本估算. 表A.48还按纸张计数使存档的痕迹正常化。 我们报告这些数字主要是为了说明为什么上述诊断性补充完全保留在本地和事后,而不是扩大为另一个长式发电运动。

blocks.en: Table A.47: Compact runtime and token/cost trace summary. The fresh rerun cost values are the provider-side totals recorded by the saved monitors under their original pricing configuration; we do not use them for cross-backend cost ranking.
blocks.zh: 表A.47:压缩运行时间和符号/成本追踪汇总。 新鲜的再运行成本值是被保存显示器在其原始定价配置下记录的提供者-侧总分;我们不使用它们进行交叉后端成本排名.

blocks.en: Table A.48: Per-100-paper normalization from archived runtime and cost traces. These historical logs time full generation/reflection rather than isolating graph construction alone; the nonlinearity between 50-paper and 200-paper groups reflects fixed generation overheads and different backend settings.
blocks.zh: 表A.48:从存档的运行时间和成本追踪中实现每100张纸的正常化。 这些历史日志全程生成/反射时间,而不是单独孤立图建;50相纸组和200相纸组之间的非线性反映了固定生成间接费用和不同的后端设置.

blocks.en: Before the stage-level timing profile, Table A.49 reports a variant-level quality/cost replay over the seven external-proxy runs. The local timings include artifact loading/context construction, graph preparation when applicable, and top- 5 5 retrieval; they exclude LLM relation induction, PDF processing, and long-form generation. Thus the table is a diagnostic overhead check, not a full pipeline cost model.
blocks.zh: 在阶段级计时简介之前,表A.49报告在7个外置代用跑道上重放变相级质量/成本. 本地时间包括:文物装载/文本构建、在适用的情况下编制图表以及取回前5名;不包括LLM关系诱导、PDF处理和长式生成。 因此,该表是一种诊断性间接费用检查,而不是一个完整的管道费用模型。

blocks.en: Table A.49: Retrieval-stage quality/cost tradeoff over seven survey-reference external-proxy runs. Graph variants increase relation density but do not dominate flat retrieval on this weak proxy; all local replays complete in roughly 0.17–0.18 seconds once artifacts exist.
blocks.zh: 表A.49:7次调查参考外部代用跑道的检索阶段质量/成本取舍。 图形变体会增加关系密度,但不会在这个弱的代理上主导平面取回;所有局部回放在文物存在后大约0.17-0.18秒内完成.

blocks.en: To better isolate the cost of the new diagnostic replays, we also profiled a local replay of graph preparation, deterministic semantic-gate filtering, and graph retrieval over the same eight archived runs. This profile reloads archived MEKGs, constructs the graph, recomputes PageRank, applies the semantic gate, and replays top- 5 5 retrieval; it does not re-run LLM relation induction or long-form generation. The local replay takes 0.148 seconds on average, split almost evenly between graph preparation and retrieval, with deterministic semantic gating adding only 0.010 seconds. In contrast, the archived content generation/reflection stage averages 110.02 minutes. This profile supports the narrow operational point that post-hoc diagnostics and evidence gating are cheap once artifacts exist, while full generation and relation induction remain the expensive components.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地隔离新的诊断重放的成本,我们还对图制的局部重放进行了剖析,确定了语义门过滤,并在相同的8个存档跑道上进行了图表检索. 这个配置文件重新装入了存档的MEKG,构造了图表,重新计算了PageRank,应用了语义门,并重放了上-5 5回取;它不重运行LLM关系感应或长形生成. 本地回放平均需要0.148秒,在图制和取回之间几乎均分出,而定心语义格特只增加0.010秒. 相形之下,存档内容生成/反演阶段平均为110.02分. 这一简介支持了狭义的操作点,即一旦文物存在后期诊断和取出证据就便宜了,而完整的生成和关系诱导仍然是昂贵的组件.

blocks.en: Table A.50: Local cost-stage replay over eight archived runs. The replay isolates artifact-local graph preparation, semantic gating, and retrieval overhead; it should not be read as the cost of re-inducing all semantic relations with LLM calls.
blocks.zh: 表A.50:8次存档运行的当地成本舞台重放。 重放分离出人工-局部图制,语义地标,和取回间接费用;不应被理解为重放所有与LLM调用的语义关系的成本.

blocks.en: Appendix D Metric Design Notes
blocks.zh: 附录D 计量设计说明

blocks.en: Graph dependence. WCR and CC are computed relative to the constructed MEKG. They measure how well the generation pipeline leverages the graph structure and are complemented by external-facing metrics (citation grounding, section alignment) in the main evaluation.
blocks.zh: 图表依赖性。 WCR和CC是相对于所构建的MEKG计算的. 它们衡量发电管道如何利用图表结构,并在主要评价中辅之以外部的衡量标准(引用地平面、区段调整)。

blocks.en: Structural coherence. SC relies on matching section topics to graph communities via lexical overlap. Across runs, SC ranges from 0.00 to 0.50, reflecting variation in topic–community alignment. We report it as one of several diagnostic signals rather than as a standalone quality indicator.
blocks.zh: 结构一致性。 SC依赖于通过词典重叠来将段落主题相匹配来图形群落. 从整体来看,SC从0.00到0.50不等,反映了主题-社区一致的变化。 我们把它报告为若干诊断信号之一,而不是一个独立的质量指标。

blocks.en: Citation grounding. The citation grounding audits (Section 5) use deterministic lexical matching and evidence-level contrasts. They provide reproducible triage of citation support quality and are designed to complement future NLI-based or human evaluation.
blocks.zh: 引证入地. 引用依据审计(第5节)采用确定性词汇匹配和证据级对比。 它们提供可复制的引文支持质量分类,旨在补充今后基于NLI或人的评价。

blocks.en: Internal QA score. The aggregate overall score combines multiple dimensions for internal run comparison. In the main text, we report controlled retrieval benchmarks and grounding audits as primary evidence.
blocks.zh: 内部QA分数. 总体总分结合多个维度进行内部运行比较. 在正文中,我们报告控制检索基准和基础审计是主要证据。

blocks.en: Appendix E Current Evaluation Implementation
blocks.zh: 附录E 当前评价的执行情况

blocks.en: The current repository implementation aggregates five dimensions: reference quality, structural soundness, content integrity, ethics/integrity, and rich media quality. When LLM-backed evaluation is enabled, the code uses a weighted ensemble over four heterogeneous judge models (MiniMax-M2.1, Kimi-K2-Thinking, Gemini-3.0-Flash-Preview, and GLM-4.7). These weights are engineering heuristics encoded in the current implementation rather than human-calibrated benchmark weights.
blocks.zh: 目前的储存库实施包括五个方面:参考质量、结构健全性、内容完整性、道德操守/完整性以及丰富的媒体质量。 当LLM支持的评价被启用后,代码使用一个加权组合来超过四个不同的判断模型(MiniMax-M2.1,Kimi-K2-Thinking,双子座-3.0-Flash-Preview,和GLM-4.7). 这些权重是目前实施中编码的工程heuristics,而不是由人类校正的基准权重.

blocks.en: This design is useful for internal QA because it surfaces multiple failure modes at once: missing references, weak section structure, unsupported analysis, poor safety discussion, or low-quality figures/tables. In the main text, we complement these internal signals with controlled retrieval benchmarks, citation grounding audits, and semantic-edge validation that provide external-facing evaluation evidence.
blocks.zh: 这种设计对于内部的QA是有用的,因为它同时会浮出多个故障模式:缺少参考文献,段落结构薄弱,不支持分析,安全讨论不畅,或者质量低的数字/表. 在正文中,我们用可控制的检索基准、引用基础审计和语义尖端验证来补充这些内部信号,以提供外向的评价证据。

blocks.zh: 附录F 执行情况 可复制性的细节

blocks.zh: 表A.51收集了易于在传言中遗漏、但对于重复所报告的诊断很重要的执行缺省。

blocks.en: Table A.51: Implementation defaults that govern the reported diagnostics. These are engineering settings from the repository, not tuned research hyperparameters.

blocks.en: Appendix G LLM Backend and Cost Statistics
blocks.zh: 附录G LLM 后端和成本统计

blocks.en: Table A.52 summarizes the LLM backends, context windows, and aggregate cost statistics for the main pipeline stages across the eight evaluation runs.
blocks.zh: 表A.52汇总了8项评价中主要管道阶段的LLM后端、上下文窗口和总成本统计。

blocks.en: Table A.52: LLM backend and per-run token consumption. Relation inference dominates at 55% of total tokens. All stages use GLM-4-Flash (free-tier API) for the archived runs; the pipeline is backend-agnostic and supports GPT-4o, Claude, Qwen, and DeepSeek via unified API routing. Mean wall-clock time per full run is 151.4 minutes for 196–200 paper corpora.
blocks.zh: 表A.52: LLM后端和每跑符消费. 关系推论占总信使的55%. 所有阶段都使用GLM-4-Flash(free-state API)进行存档跑道;管线为后端-可知性,并通过统一的API路由支持GPT-4o,克洛德,克文和DeepSeek. 每跑一次平均时长为151.4分钟,为196-200纸币.

blocks.en: The cost breakdown confirms that relation inference is the dominant expense (55% of tokens), followed by narrative synthesis (28%) and outline generation (9%). Because the pipeline uses a free-tier API (GLM-4-Flash) for the reported experiments, the direct monetary cost is zero; equivalent runs on commercial APIs (GPT-4o-mini at $0.15/1M input tokens) would cost approximately $0.50 per full survey generation. The MEKG construction cost is amortized across downstream stages: once built, the graph supports unlimited retrieval queries and outline variants without additional LLM calls.
blocks.zh: 成本细目证实,关系推论是主要开支(占象征物的55%),其次是叙述综合(28%)和提纲生成(9%)。 由于管道在报告的实验中使用了自由级API(GLM-4-Flash),直接的货币成本为零;当量运行于商业API(GPT-4o-mini,0.15/1M输入令牌),每整代调查大约需要0.50美元. MEKG的建造成本分出下游各个阶段分期摊销:一旦建成,图支持无限检索查询和大纲变体,而无需额外的LLM调用.

blocks.en: Appendix I ROC-Style Evidence Gate Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录一 ROC-Style 证据门分析

blocks.en: Figure A.1 shows the precision–recall–F1 tradeoff as the confidence threshold for edge inclusion varies. The analysis uses the 108 annotated edges with human-adjudicated labels as ground truth.
blocks.zh: 图A.1显示精确的-回顾-F1取舍,因为边缘纳入的信心阈值各不相同。 分析使用108个有人判断标签的注解边缘作为地上真理.

blocks.en: Figure A.1: Left: ROC curve for the evidence gate (AUC=0.75). Right: Precision, recall, and F1 as a function of the confidence threshold. The optimal threshold (0.35) retains 74% of edges while achieving F1=0.81.
blocks.zh: 图A.1:左:证据门的ROC曲线(AUC=0.75)。 对:精度,回想,和F1作为置信阈值的函数. 最佳阈值(0.35)保留了74%的边缘,同时实现F1=0.81.

blocks.en: The per-relation-type analysis reveals that improves and applies edges are well-separated from noise (F1 > > 0.88 at their respective optimal thresholds), while extends requires a higher threshold (0.80) for acceptable precision (F1=0.59). This is consistent with the observation that implicit methodological lineage is harder to validate from surface features.
blocks.zh: 亲和型分析显示,改进和应用边缘与噪声(F1 > > > 0.88,在各自的最佳阈值下)完全分离,而扩展则需要更高的阈值(0.80),以达到可接受的精度(F1=0.59). 这与以下观点是一致的:隐含的方法分界线较难从地表地貌中验证.

blocks.en: Appendix J MVSS and StructSurvey Comparison Boundaries
blocks.zh: 附录J MVSS 和 StructSurvey 比较边界

We keep these comparisons for positioning and design context, but we do not report them as a same-topic, same-budget, same-backend live rerun or as evidence of statistically significant end-to-end superiority. The Qwen diagnostics in Appendix B.3 are same-backend controls among SurveyGraph variants only; they do not remove backend confounds against MVSS or StructSurvey.
blocks.zh: 表A.54记录了本文件中我们如何使用并行系统。 我们对定位和设计背景进行这些比较,但我们不把它们报告为同主题,同预算,同后端直播重播,或作为统计上重要的端到端优势的证据. 附录B.3中的Quen诊断只是SurveyGraph变体中的同后端控制;它们不会去除后端对MVSS或StructSurvey的集合.

blocks.en: Prior structure- and coverage-oriented systems, including StructSurvey and SurveyForge, report that structural or coverage-aware retrieval can help over flat baselines ( Pedinotti and Santus, 2026 ; Yan et al., 2025 ) . SurveyX likewise emphasizes citation-quality evaluation ( Liang et al., 2025 ) . These works motivate our typed design, but their corpora and evaluation protocols differ from ours; we therefore treat them as related-work context and do not merge their metrics with SurveyGraph’s diagnostics.
blocks.zh: 包括StructSurvey和SurveyForge在内的先前面向结构和覆盖的系统报告说,结构或覆盖感检索有助于超过平坦基线(Pedinotti和Santus,2026;Yan等,2025年)。 调查 X同样强调引用质量评价(梁等,2025.). 这些作品激励着我们的打字设计,但是他们的公司和评价协议与我们的不同;因此,我们将它们视为相关的工作背景,不把它们的衡量标准与SurveyGraph的诊断方法合并。

blocks.zh: 表A.54:同时系统比较的边界条件。 这些行用于背景化SurveyGraph的设计,而不是作为同后端的端到端的基准或意义测试.

blocks.en: Appendix K Prompts Used
blocks.zh: 附录 K 提示 已使用

blocks.en: We retain two representative prompt templates because they are directly tied to the current implementation. They are included here as implementation evidence rather than as proof of prompt-level optimization.
blocks.zh: 我们保留了两个具有代表性的即时模板,因为它们与目前的执行直接相关。 这里将它们列为执行证据,而不是迅速优化的证据。

blocks.en: MEKG Relation Inference Prompt You are an expert researcher. Analyze the relationship between two research papers based on their details. Paper A (Source) : - Title: {title_a} - Method: {method_a} - Innovation: {innovation_a} - Abstract: {abstract_a} Paper B (Target) : - Title: {title_b} - Method: {method_b} - Innovation: {innovation_b} - Abstract: {abstract_b} Determine the semantic relationship from Paper A to Paper B and return a structured record with: relation type, confidence, short rationale, and whether the relation should be none if the evidence only shows topical similarity. Candidate labels include extends , improves , applies , compares , supports , refutes , and none .
blocks.zh: MEKG 关系推论提示 你是一个专家研究员。 根据其细节分析出两份研究论文之间的关系. 论文A(资料来源):- 标题 : {title_a} - 方法 : {方法_a} - 创新:{创新-a} - 摘要 : {a} 论文B(目标):- 标题 : {title_b} - 方法 : {方法_b} - 创新:{创新-b} - 摘要 {摘要_b} 确定从纸A到纸B的语义关系,并返回结构化的记录,内容包括:关系类型,信心,短理由,如果证据仅显示主题相似,关系是否应当为无. 候选人的标签包括扩展、改进、应用、比较、支持、反驳和无。

blocks.en: For the semantic-edge audits, we used the following labeling rule over saved candidate edges: supported requires direct abstract/title evidence for the specific relation; partial means compatible topic, method, or downstream-use evidence but no explicit lineage statement; unsupported covers temporal reversal, target-role mismatch, cross-task mismatch, or a claim stronger than the local evidence. The negative-control audit additionally samples same-run non-edge paper pairs so that none -style cases are explicitly represented in the evidence rather than only in the prompt.
blocks.zh: 对于语义前沿审计,我们使用以下关于被保存候选边际的标签规则: 支持为特定关系需要直接抽象/标题证据; 部分意味着兼容的主题,方法,或下游使用证据,但没有明确的分界线说明; 不支持涵盖时间倒转,目标-作用不匹配,跨任务不匹配,或比当地证据更强烈的主张. 此外,负控制审计还抽取了同运行的非对冲纸对,这样,证据中就没有任何一类案件得到明确反映,而不只是及时反映。

blocks.en: MEKG-Driven Outline Generation Prompt You are a senior academic survey expert. Generate a hierarchical survey outline grounded in the provided MEKG structure. ## Major Research Communities {communities} ## Core Papers {core_papers} ## Research Evolution Timeline {evolution_paths} ## Mandatory Rules 1. Main sections must derive from major MEKG communities. 2. Subsections should reflect meaningful subthemes or evolutionary stages. 3. The final outline should balance canonical structure with data-driven discoveries.
blocks.zh: MEKG 驱动大纲生成提示 你是高级学术调查专家 以所提供的MEKG结构为基础编制分级调查大纲。 □主要研究社区{社区} □ 核心文件{核心_纸张} □ 研究进化 时间线{ evolution_ paths} {\fn华文仿宋\fs16\1cHD1D1D1} 强制性规则 1. 主要部门必须来自主要的MEKG社区。 2. 分节应反映有意义的分主题或演变阶段。 3. 最后大纲应兼顾犬科结构与数据驱动的发现。

blocks.en: Appendix L Generated Survey Examples
blocks.zh: 附录 L 调查实例

blocks.en: We present excerpts from three surveys generated end-to-end by SurveyGraph on distinct research topics. Each row shows three consecutive pages (title page, introduction, and body) to illustrate the system’s ability to produce coherent multi-page academic documents with structured abstracts, logical section flow, and domain-appropriate content organization.
